...If you can find me, that is.

Hmm... this is starting to be fun...

Go when you've learned to swim someday, all right?

Oh?

I'm the 100-Year-Old Man... Do you need something?

Sorry, I was lost in thought...

...Oh, that's right!!
Would you do me a favor?
The favor is, you see...

You must have seen it on your way here —
that red bird, Kokka...

It steals eggs from other places
and keeps them as its own...

Left like that,
the chicks inside will suffer...

So, would you gather all the chicks from the eggs around here?

I'm worried about them...
I'm counting on you.

What, you've already collected them?

Hmmmm...
But it seems some are still left...

Sorry, but could you go once more?

Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmmmm...

But it seems there are still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・\nおおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではな:
What, they've already been gathered...?
Oh my! And you even got all of them!
......But where are the chicks?

Oh... my... god!!

You kept them in your stomach!?

Well, they don't seem to have been digested, so I suppose it's fine...

Anyway, thank you for your trouble.
...Now I can rest easy.

Hm?... Oh yes, yes.
You seem to have had some business with me.

......Hoh......
The Koma Buta took your grandfather's keepsake bracelet...?

So you want to ask about the Koma Buta...

Hm, I see...
The truth is...
entries.集めてくれたのか?\n\n・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな\n・・・・・:
Did you collect them?

...Oh!! It seems you've gathered them all.
......But where are the chicks?

That's as far as I can tell you...

If you go on down the road ahead,
try looking for my friends.
They're sure to help you...
entries.あとは・・・ そうじゃな・・・\n\nアイテムを 手にいれたら・・\n「アイテム:

Once you get an item...
choose "Look" in the "Item" command
and study it carefully...

You're sure to notice something...

Oh? It's gone...
I meant to give you the 100-Year Bell,
but...

It seems I lost it somewhere...

If you find something that looks like it,
bring it to me...

In exchange, I'll give you this...
Here, take this — the 100-Year Key.
entries.これで、ここにあるのとおなじ宝箱なら\nあけることができるようになったはずじゃ・:
With this, you should now be able to open treasure chests just like the ones here...
Hmm, what luck...

And... to find the Evil Pigs,
you'll need something called a Seal Bag...

Without it,
their hiding places can't be seen...

They should be able to tell you more about it.

...The road ahead is still long...
Don't rush and get hurt...
entries.・・・おおっ、これはまさしく100年のすず!\nよく見つけたのぉ・・・\n\nこ:
...Oh, this is indeed the 100-Year Bell!
Well done finding it...

If you use this,
you should be able to come back here any time...
entries.よく やったのぉ・・・・・・\n\nこれで この大陸も もとの静けさを\nとりも:
You did it, huh...

With this, this continent will surely return to its former tranquility...
entries.ふん! \nまぁ、マグレじゃろうけどな・・・:
Hmm!
Well, it's probably just a fluke, though...
entries.ほっ ほっ ほっ・・・\n何を言うとる・・・\n\nいちばん心配しとったクセに・:
Ho ho ho...
What are you saying...?

You were the most worried about it...
You're not very honest, are you...?
entries.なっ! 何を・・・\n別に わしは心配なんか・・・・・・:
What! What...?
I'm not worried at all...
entries.まぁまぁ・・・\n・・・ともかく・・・\n\nこの少年の勇気が \n皆を救ってく:
Now, now...
...Anyway...

This boy's courage
saved everyone.
entries.・・・そうじゃな・・・・\n・・で?\nおまえさんの目的は はたせたのかな?\n:
...Yes, that's so...
...And?
Did you accomplish your goal?

.....
....I see.
...I'm glad.
entries.・・・そうか・・・\n\n・・・わしら時の老人は トンバとともにある・・・\n・:
...I see...

...We, the Old Men of Time, are always with Tomba...
...If anything happens, come visit us again
entries.げ・・・元気でな・・・\n\n気をつけてかえれよ・・・\n\nカゼひくなよ・・・:
T-take care...

Be careful on your way home...

Don't catch a cold...

Um, and also......
entries.まったく・・・\n自分のマゴに話してるみたいじゃな・・・\nほっ ほっ ほっ・・:
Honestly...
It's like I'm talking to my own grandchild...
Ho ho ho...
entries.・・・恵みコゾウが復活すると、幻の塔が現れる・・・: ...When the Megumi Kozo revive, the Phantom Tower appears...
entries.・・・ドワーフの集落に花の種をまくと、\n 金色の花がさく・・・:
...When you sow flower seeds in the Dwarf Settlement,
golden flowers will bloom...
entries.・・・山の頂上には、かくれた村がある・・・: At the top of the mountain lies a hidden village...
entries.・・・ウワサを聞いた後、納屋のある小屋に\n 魔女がかえってくる・・・:
...After hearing the rumor, the Witch returns
to the hut with the barn...

Save?

Hey! Did I startle you?
...I'm collecting Leaf Butterflies...

Rumor has it Leaf Butterflies have
a mysterious power...

If you gather a few of them,
something amazing is supposed to happen...

If you want to see what happens,
put the Leaf Butterflies you've caught
in this bug cage.
entries.なんだ・・・もう\nもってたのか・・・: What... did you already have it...?
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今2匹ぐらいだな・・・:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There are about two Leaf Butterflies now...
entries.な!?・・・何だ、何だ?: What?! ... What is this? What is this?
entries.・・・おりれなくなっちゃった\n\n花の種をさがしにきたんだけど・・・\nどこに:
...I can't get down.

I came looking for flower seeds, but...
I can't find any anywhere...

I want to go home...
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nつれてってくれるの?\n・・・・・・ありがとう!:
...Older brother, will you take me with you?
...Thank you!
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nそっちじゃないとおもうよ:
...Big brother,
I don't think it's that way.
entries.いや・・・\nどこにもいない:
No...
He's nowhere to be found.
entries.やはり、\nただのウワサか?: Is it just a rumor after all?
entries.いや、それ\nわからない・・・\n\nでも、このもりで\n見たドワーフいる:
No, that I don't know...

But there's a dwarf who saw him in this forest.
entries.でも、いくら 大ドロボウでも\nこんなところまでぬけ道つくるのは、とても大変・・: But even for a great thief, creating a secret passage like this is incredibly difficult...
entries.・・・もういちど、\n地下ロウみにいく: ...I'm going to the underground prison again.
entries.・・・うわぁっ!!!\n・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・\nなんだ、いつかのガ:
...Whoa!!!
...B-...Boy, I was startled...
Oh, it's that kid from before...
entries.い、いやぁ・・・\nやっと、ここから出してもらえてさぁ・・・\nけ、けっして ぬ:
W-well...
I was finally let out of here...
I d-didn't escape, I swear...
Well, I'll be going now...
entries.よぉ・・・お前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・\nどうだい?オレと ひとしょうぶしな:
Hey... I've been waiting for you to come...
How about it? Want to have a match with me?
entries.じつは、この先の高見ヤグラのてっぺんに\nある宝をかくしておいたんだ\n\nそこ:
Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the top of the Watch Tower up ahead.

Here's the deal: start from the bottom of the Watch Tower,
and if you reach the treasure before I do,
it's yours...

How about it? Sounds fun, right?
entries.はぁ・・・はぁ・・・\nお前さん はやいなぁ・・・\n\nしょうがない、オレのま:
Haa... haa...
You're fast, aren't you...

Well, I guess I'm losing...
I'll give you that treasure...
entries.いやぁ、ひさしぶりに\nたのしかったゼ\n・・・じゃあ、アバヨ!: Wow, it was really fun after a long time... Well then, bye!
entries.どうやら、オレの\nかち みたいだな・・・: It seems like it's my victory...

Hmm? What's this, a frustrated-looking face...
Well, I'm just bored anyway...

If you ever want to try again, feel free to talk to me anytime.

Alright! Time for a retry...
Well then, let's go down...
entries.あの犬、ケガしてるみたいで\nあそこからおりられないんだ:
That puppy looks hurt,
and it can't get down from there
entries.あの犬、\nもどってきちゃったね:
That puppy
has come back, hasn't it
entries.このさき嵐の山・・・\n\nいつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・\nわし、:
Beyond here is Storm Mountain...

A very dangerous mountain where a strong wind always blows...
The Elder told me to keep watch here...
...but it's awfully boring...

So I always practice here.
Eh? Practice for what?

......The truth is, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is really hard...
What kind of face should I make to move everyone...?
entries.おおっ!そのカオ、\nそのひょうじょう・・・とてもいい!!\n\n・・・なるほど:
Oh! That face, that expression... wonderful!!

...I see...
...hm-hm...
...mm, this is very helpful.
entries.・・・う〜ん\n・・・でも、まだ何か足りない・・・\n\nたとえば・・・\n人に:
...Hmm...
...but something's still missing...

For example...
what kind of face should I make
to convey sadness to people?...
entries.ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!\nそ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・\n・・・:
Huh?... Whoooa!
T-that face full of sorrow!...
...I see...

If I master that laughing face from before and that crying face now...
Hm-hm...
...Mmmmmm...

I see it!!
Yes! Thank you!!

Thanks to you, I feel like I'm onto something!
Oops, no time to lose.
...Time to start training!!
entries.おっと、わすれてた・・・\nさっき、長老、山の方へ入っていった・・・\n\n何で:
Oops, I forgot...
The Elder just went off toward the mountain...

He seems to have business with you...
You'd better hurry.
entries.立ち入り禁止\nこの森には怪物がすんでいます。\n\nキケンですので立ち入らない:
KEEP OUT
Monsters live in this forest.

It is dangerous, so please do not enter.
Bacchus Village Nature Management Office
entries.おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・\n花のナミダ、めぐみさまの復活にかかせない・・:
I came to get Flower Tears...
Flower Tears are essential to reviving Lady Megumi...

But...
I don't know how to collect the tears...
entries.高見ヤグラの下のほう、\n木でできてるところ・・・\n\nこわれやすいから\n気:
The lower part of the Watch Tower,
the part made of wood...

It breaks easily,
so you'd better be careful...
entries.あの、まんなかにいるのが\nめぐみコゾウさまたち・・・\nでも、うごかない・・・:
The ones in the middle are
the Megumi Kozo...
But they don't move...
entries.ココロあらわれるこのポーズ\n・・・うつくしい・・・: This pose that reveals the heart... beautiful...
entries.めぐみさまが復活し、\n動きはじめるとき・・・\n何かがおこるといわれてる・・・:
When Lady Megumi revives
and starts to move...
they say something will happen...
entries.ここ、めぐみの広場・・・\n魔ブタの魔法さえとければ、\nもっとキレイなところ・:
Here, Megumi Plaza...
If only the Evil Pig's magic were undone,
it would be a prettier place...
entries.キノコの森には\n怪物がすんでるというウワサ・・・\n気をつけたほうがいい・・・:
There's a rumor that a monster lives in the Mushroom Forest...
You should be careful...
entries.そう言えば、めぐみさまの\n動いてるところ・・・\nだれも見たことない・・・:
Come to think of it,
no one has ever seen
Lady Megumi move...
entries.わし、きょうは村の\n地下ロウの見はり当番・・・\n\nあれ?これ、\nないしょ:
Today I'm on guard duty at the village's
underground prison...

Huh? Wasn't this a secret??
entries.この森も、昔はキレイな花が\nいっぱい咲いてた・・・\nこれもみんな、魔ブタのせ:
This forest too used to be
full of beautiful flowers...
It's all the Evil Pigs' fault...
entries.魔ブタのかくれ家、\n目には見えないらしい・・・\n\nでも、入口は\nどこかに:
The Evil Pigs' hideout
apparently can't be seen...

But there must be an entrance
somewhere...
entries.ここは・・・もう知ってるよね・・・: This is... you already know, right?
entries.バッカスの湖にある水は、\nぜんぶアルコール・・・\n\nよっぱらうから、\n気:
The water in Bacchus Lake
is all alcohol...

You'll get drunk,
so you'd better be careful...
entries.めぐみさまを復活させるには\nなにかが必要らしい・・・\n\nえ〜と・・・\nど:
It seems you need something
to revive Lady Megumi...

Let me see...
I forgot...
entries.ん?・・・\nめぐみさまを復活させるもの?\n\n・・・そういえば、なにかの\n:
Hm?...
What revives Lady Megumi?

...Come to think of it,
I hear you need some kind of tears...
entries.めぐみコゾウさま、\n人気者・・・みんな、\nこの広場にあつまってくる:
The Megumi Kozo are popular...
everyone gathers
in this square
entries.嵐の山にも魔ブタの魔法が\nかかっているらしい・・・\n封印ぶくろ、どこかにある:
It seems the Evil Pigs' magic has been cast on Storm Mountain too...
There must be a Seal Bag somewhere...
entries.ときどき、森の地面の下から、\nものおとがきこえてくる・・・\nちょっとコワイ・:
Sometimes noises come from under the forest floor...
It's a little scary...
entries.シーフマンション、\nたくさんの小部屋がある\n\n・・・全部見たか?\n・・・:
Thief Mansion
has lots of small rooms.

...Have you seen them all?
...It's tough, but...
entries.この先のリーフスライダーをぬけて、\nキノコの森を左に行けば、\n海辺がある・・:
Go through the Leaf Slider ahead
and take the Mushroom Forest to the left,
and you'll find the seaside...
entries.キノコの森のむこうがわには、\nバッカスの村と湖がある・・・: Beyond the Mushroom Forest lies the village of Bacchus and a lake...
entries.1000年の宝箱に いどうにべんりな\nグルピン かくされているらしい・・・:
It seems a Grapple, handy for getting around,
is hidden in the 1,000-Year Treasure Chest...
entries.なかま・・・みつかっていない・・・\nここからさきは いかないほうがいい:
The companions... haven't been found...
You shouldn't go any further from here
entries.ドワーフのこども 迷子になった・・・\nもりのおくへ いかないように\nみはって:
A dwarf child got lost...
I'm keeping watch so no one goes
deeper into the forest...
entries.よぉ!びっくりしたかい?\n・・・オレは、カレハチョウを集めてるんだ・・・:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting Leaf Butterflies...
entries.ウワサによると、\nカレハチョウにはふしぎな力があって・・・\n何匹か集めるとス:
According to the rumors,
Leaf Butterflies have a mysterious power...
If you gather a few of them, something amazing is supposed to happen...
entries.何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、\nつかまえた カレハチョウを\nこのムシカ:
If you want to see what happens,
put the Leaf Butterflies you've caught
in this bug cage
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今・・・\n00匹ぐらいだな・・:
Hii... fuu... mii...
Right now there are
about 00 Leaf Butterflies...
entries.今回のバージョンは、ここまでです。\nこの先のエリアに進むと\nゲームは自動的に:
This version ends here.
If you go on to the area ahead,
the game ends automatically.
entries.ありゃりゃ・・・もう見つかっちゃった\n・・・よーし、つぎで しょうぶだ!:
Aw... you found me already
...Alright, next time we settle it!
entries.・・・おっ、やっと気がついたかい\n・・・いやぁ、ひどい目にあったなぁ\n\n・:
...Oh, you've come to at last
...Boy, did I have a terrible time

...I flew through the sky for a while,
then the bug cage fell apart on the way...

Next thing I knew,
I'd been dropped in a place like this...
entries.やめた、やめた!・・・\n何が伝説のカレハチョウだよ・・・\n\nあんたも あき:
I quit, I quit!...
What's so legendary about the Leaf Butterfly anyway...

You'd better give up too.
...Huh? Butterflies?... Oh,

the Leaf Butterflies are gathered over there
around that egg-like thing.
What a waste of time...

Well, I'm off... wait,
where the heck is this place?
entries.始まりの村で、サンタとかいう\nサルみかけた・・・\nはらへって動けないとかなん:
In the Village of Beginnings I saw a monkey called Santa...
He said he was too hungry to move or something...
entries.トンバも めぐみコゾウさま 見にきたか?\n・・・きっといいことある・・・\nた:
Did Tomba come to see the Megumi Kozo too?
...Something good is sure to happen...
Probably...
entries.マグマのどうくつも\n魔ブタの魔法かかってる\n\n・・・炎けすには\n魔ブタを:
The Lava Cave is under
the Evil Pigs' magic too.

...To put out the flames,
you have to seal the Evil Pigs...
entries.シーフマンション・・・むかし、\nとうぞくの すみかだったところ・・・:
Thief Mansion...
a place where thieves once lived...

There are about three Leaf Butterflies now...

entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今1匹ぐらいだな・・・:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There's about one Leaf Butterfly now...
entries.知ってるか?・・・キノコの森には\nひとつのキノコで泣いたり、\n笑ったりできる:
Do you know? ...It seems there's something in Mushroom Forest that can make you cry or laugh with just one mushroom.

...I haven't seen it myself, though.
entries.このおく・・・地面がすべり台みたいになってる・・・\nみんな、リーフスライダーと:
This... the ground looks like a slide...
Everyone calls it the Leaf Slider, but...

It's a little dangerous... so I can't let you pass here... crying won't help...
entries.お・・・おい・・・\nほんとうに泣いてるのか\n\n・・・いや・・・\nあれは:
O... hey...
Are you really crying?

...No...
That was just a parable...

Got it... I'll let you through, so stop crying now...
entries.わし、むかし じいさんから\nふしぎな話聞いた・・・\n\n赤い花に・・・粉をか:
I once heard a strange story from my grandfather...

When you sprinkle powder on a red flower...
it turns blue... when red and blue combine... um... also,

I forgot...
entries.◎のコ□バ・・・\n○にを◎△て○ん●かな・・・:
The ◎ of □ba...
I wonder if ○ can be ◎△ed to ○n●...
entries.ここは・・・恵みの広場!\n\n・・・ほんとーの、恵みの広場!!:
This is... Megumi Square!

...The real Megumi Square!!
entries.森も、もとにもどった\n\n・・・あとは\n恵みさまの復活を待つばかり・・・:
The forest has returned to normal too

...All that's left
is to wait for Lady Megumi's revival...
entries.トンバ・・・\nドカピンって 知ってるか?・・・:
Tomba...
Do you know Grapple Jack?...
entries.ドワーフ、\nトンバを おうえんしてる・・・\n\nおうえんだけだけど・・・:
The dwarves
are cheering Tomba on...

Only cheering, though...
entries.トンバ、つよい!\nわし、よわい・・・\n\n恵みさま、エライ!\nわし、エラク:
Tomba is strong!
I am weak...

Lady Megumi is great!
I am not great...

Sigh...
entries.ここは・・・恵みの広場!\nしかもミリオンの塔つき!!:
This is... Megumi Plaza!
And it even has the Million Tower!!
entries.恵みさま・・・\n2人だけ のこった・・・:
Lady Megumi...
only two are left...
entries.これがウワサに聞く ミリオンの塔!\nでも、どうやって入る?:
This is the Million Tower you hear about in rumors!
But how do you get in?
entries.恵みさま スゴイ!\n・・・ちいさな芽が\nこんなに大きくなった!:
Lady Megumi is amazing!
...The little buds
have grown this big!
entries.この上・・・一体 何があるのか?\n・・・・・・とっても気になる・・・:
What on earth is there above this...?
...I'm really curious...
entries.ハハハ・・・ビックリしたかい?\n\nこの塔に 入りたいんだったら\nたくさんA:
Hahaha... did I startle you?

If you want to enter this tower,
you'll have to collect lots of AP!
entries.こうやってないと・・・\nミリオンの塔が\nまたしぼんじゃうんだ・・・:
If I don't keep doing this...
the Million Tower
will wither again...
entries.なんだい?\nオイラのべんとうを 持って来てくれたのか・・・\n\nそう・・・と:
What's this?
You brought my lunch box...?

I see... Dad made it for me.
But I'm not hungry right now,
so you can eat the lunch box yourself...

Oh! That's right, you can have this too. See you!
entries.え? とうさんから\nあずかった べんとう\n食べちゃったの・・・\n\nう〜ん:
Huh? You ate
the lunch box Dad gave you to bring me...?

Hmm, well, I guess it's fine,
if you enjoyed it.

Well, I'm off... See you later!

entries.森の地下には何がある?: What is there in the forest's underground?
entries.動かない鉄の車: The Iron Car That Doesn't Move
entries.夢?幻?宝物庫を探せ: Dream? Illusion? Find the Treasure Vault

Forest Underground Labyrinth

Save?

entries.わし、けっこうアタマいい\nおまえのコトバわかる・・・けど、\nおまえ、ドワーフ:
I'm pretty smart.
I understand your language... but
you don't know the Dwarf language...

If you bite a dwarf,
you can learn our language...
Once might not be enough, though...
entries.◎のまえ●、◎◎\nいなくな△た・・・: The ◎ in front of ●, the ◎◎ disappeared…
entries.目のまえで、なかま\nいなくなった・・・:
Right before my eyes, my friend
disappeared...
entries.どうしようかねぇ・・・\nあれがないと こまるんだけどねぇ\n・・・おや、きいて:
What should I do...
I'm in trouble without that...
...Oh, were you listening?

...The truth is... I hid something important
in the forest, but...

The forest is crawling with Koma Buta now,
so I can't go get it...
It's really important to me, though...
entries.森の中に だいじなものを\nかくしておいたんだけど・・・\n\n今の森には、コマ:
I hid something important
in the forest, but...

The forest is crawling with Koma Buta now,
so I can't go get it...
It's really important to me, though...
entries.おやっ!これ、\nとってきてくれたのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・\n\nえんりょ:
Oh! Did you fetch this for me?
How nice...

I'll gladly take it.
......Here it comes, here it comes!
entries.・・・ふうーーーっ\n\nじつは、おなかの中に\nガスがたまってて\nくるしかっ:
...Phhhew

The truth is, gas had built up in my belly,
and it was agony.

You saved me.
...Thank you.

...Oh yes, I don't really know what it is, but

...please take this in return...

It's supposed to be something rare.
entries.この火、消さない・・・\nこれ わしのしごと・・・:
I won't let this fire go out...
This is my job...
entries.ん?なんだ、おまえ\nこれ欲しいのか?\n\n・・・火、あぶないから\nきをつけ:
Hm? What, you want this? ⏎

...Fire is dangerous,
so be careful carrying it...
entries.お〜い・・・ だれかいないかぁ〜\n・・・あかりがきれたぞぉ〜:
Hey... Is anyone there?
...The lights have gone out!
entries.こども!・・・こども見なかったか?\n\nこども、高見ヤグラに 花のたね\nさが:
Child!... Have you seen my child?

My child went to the Watch Tower to look for flower seeds
and hasn't come back!

I'm worried, so worried...
Terribly worried...
entries.・・・まだひとりも、\nかえってこない・・・: ...Not one of them has come back yet...
entries.しんぱい、しんぱい・・・\nとてもしんぱい・・・:
I'm worried, I'm worried...
I'm very worried...
entries.おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!\n\nおまえ、とてもやさしいこころもっ:
Oh! You rescued my child!

You have a very kind heart
...I'm very happy.

As thanks, take this — I'm sure it will help you.
entries.こども見つけてくれて\nありがとう・・・\nわしとおまえ、ともだち:
Thank you for finding my child...
You and I are friends.
entries.おにいちゃん、\n花のたね みつけたら\nおしえてね!: Hey, big brother, if you find flower seeds, let me know!
entries.この花だんにお花咲かせたいなぁ・・・\n\nちょっと前までは、\n森にたくさんの:
I want to make flowers bloom in this flowerbed...

Until a little while ago,
there were lots of seeds in the forest...

But now they've all withered...

I get the feeling it isn't only the Evil Pigs' doing, though...
entries.もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if I'll never see flowers again...
entries.おまえ、APと書かれた\nへんなモノ見たか?: Did you see that weird thing with "AP" written on it?
entries.わしらのなかま、あれと同じ\nマークの入った箱やリングも\n見たこと、あるらしい:
It seems my friends have seen boxes and rings
with the same mark as that thing...
entries.どうすれば、ひらくか?\n・・・気になる・・・:
How do I open it?
...I'm curious...
entries.ドワーフ、\nとてもこまってる・・・:
The dwarves
are in great trouble...
entries.くわしいはなし、ひろばにいる\nなかまがしってる・・・:
My friends in the square
know the details...
entries.おお、おまえ、\nドワーフのことばわかるか!?\nドワーフ、とてもこまってる\n:
Oh, you understand the Dwarf language!?
The dwarves are in great trouble...

...The truth is...
this Dwarf Forest
is under the Evil Pig's magic...

The flowers withered, and the trees
changed their shape...

Just now, seven of our friends
were surrounded by plants in the forest
and went missing...

They must be inside one of the big plants,
or caught by spores
and unable to move...

Quickly we opened the hut in the forest
and the door near the village entrance,
and went to keep watch deep in the forest.

...If you don't find our friends,
they won't let you through
to the back of the forest...
entries.なかま見つからないと、\n森のおく\nとおしてくれないはず・・・:
If you don't find our friends,
they won't let you
through to the back of the forest...
entries.おお・・・なかま、\nぜんいん助けてくれたか・・・\nほんとうにありがとう:
Oh... you saved all of our friends...
Thank you so much.
entries.ドワーフの長老、\nとてもよろこんでる・・・\nはなし きいてみるといい:
The Dwarf Elder
is delighted...
You should go hear what he has to say.
entries.・・・7人のなかま、\nかえってきたけど\n\n・・・じつは、\nこどもがひとり:
...The seven friends
have come back, but

...the truth is,
one child

is still lost
in the forest...
entries.おまえ、とても、ゆうきある\nドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする:
You are very brave.
Dwarf respects you.
entries.勇気ある少年よ・・・\nわしがドワーフの\n長老ですじゃ・・・:
Brave boy...
I am the Elder
of the Dwarves...
entries.7人のドワーフは\nかえってきたんじゃが・・・\n\n子どもがまだ\nかえってこ:
The seven dwarves have come back,
but...

the child still
hasn't come back...
entries.子どもの父親は、この集落の\n入口のちかくの家におる・・・\n話をきいてくれんか:
The child's parents are in the house
near the entrance of this settlement...
Won't you go and listen to them?
entries.村人全員になりかわり、\n礼を言わせてほしい・・・\n\nなかまをたすけてくれて:
On behalf of all the villagers,
allow me to thank you...

Thank you so much
for helping our friends...

It's such a small village that
we can't offer you much of a reward...

...Oh, that's right...
I heard from the 100-Year-Old Man,

that you're chasing after the Evil Pigs...
entries.おぉ、あったあった、\nこれじゃ・・・:
Ah, here it is,
here it is...
entries.これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの\n封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・\n\nこれが:
This is the Seal Bag of the Evil Pig
who cast the spell on this forest...

With this, just by approaching
where an Evil Pig is hiding,
it should find the entrance to the hideout —
the Evil Pig Gate — for you...
entries.でも、魔ブタ、\n自分が魔法をかけた場所には\nかくれない・・・:
But the Evil Pig
never hides in a place
it has cast its magic on...
entries.それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、\n1匹づつ封印できる\n\:
Also, each Evil Pig has its own Seal Bag,
and you can seal them one at a time.

...In other words, seven Evil Pigs
need seven Seal Bags.
entries.ふくろ、\n魔法をかけられた場所の\nちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・:
The bags should surely be
near the places where the magic was cast...
entries.魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、\nそれぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが\n一:
If you want to know where the Evil Pigs are,
finding each Seal Bag
is the quickest way...

But... the Evil Pigs' power is mighty...
Don't push yourself too hard...

There's no need to guard the back of the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.そうじゃな・・・まずは\n大トリの山へ行ってみなされ\n\n・・・あそこも昔は\:
Let me see...
First, go to Great Bird Mountain.

...That too was a quiet mountain once...

And now that storm...
The Evil Pigs' magic must be cast on it...
entries.魔ブタ・・・\n自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・\n\n封印ぶくろあれ:
The Evil Pigs...
never hide in places they cast magic on...

With a Seal Bag,
you can find the Evil Pig Gate...

But each Evil Pig has its own Seal Bag,
and you can seal them one at a time...

In other words, seven Evil Pigs
need seven Seal Bags...

The bags are sure to be
near the places where the magic was cast...
entries.ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・\n\nおまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・\nだか:
Dwarves are good at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you're ever in trouble,
ask one of our friends...
entries.ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?\n\nでも、ドワーフが切るのは\nやくめをおえた:
Hm... you want a tree cut down?

But dwarves only cut old trees
that have finished their purpose...

Anyway, I'll follow you...
entries.・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・\nじゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・:
...Yes, this tree is fine...
Then stand back a little and wait...
entries.おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?\nこまったねぇ・・・\n\n実は、村のド:
Oh, you're looking for Elder too?
What a bother...

Actually, two Dwarves in the village have started fighting...
Normally I'd just leave it alone, but...

And of all places, they're brawling right at the village entrance, making it impossible to get out...

...Could you stop them?
entries.長老がいたら、\n一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・:
If only the Elder were here,
he'd settle it in one go...
entries.うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!\n\nそんなの すぐに見つかる・・・\n\:
I hid it well, so it's fine!

Something like that will be found right away...

No, I should apologize after all!
entries.あの2人、長老から\n何かあずかってたらしい・・・: It seems those two received something from Elder...
entries.ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!\n\nおまえがわるい!\n\nいや、こわした:
S-see... I knew it would be found!

It's your fault!

No, you're the one who broke it!
entries.ぶわっかもーん!!\nわしの大事なつぼを\nこわすとはなにごとゃ!:
You fool!!
What do you mean by breaking
my precious pot!
entries.ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・\nおまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといて:
Phew... I finally managed to escape from this hole...
Sorry, but could you please fill this hole back in?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
While we're at it... could you go take a look?
entries.ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、\nいちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、\:
Phew... since you took so long to come,
I came back to the village once,
and fell right into this hole...

I finally got out of the hole...

...Sorry, but could you
fill in this hole for me?

...But who on earth dug such a hole...

I'll be waiting up on the mountain again...
Don't keep an old man waiting too long...
entries.・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!\nぬけ道をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!\n\n・・:
......Ah! You!
Aren't you the brat who blocked the secret passage!

...Jeez...
I saw my chance while the dwarves weren't looking and tried to run,
and you plugged the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to you,
I'm right back in jail, as you can see...
entries.これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか\nパン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・\n\nそうだ:
At this rate I can't even steal a slice of bread,
let alone the mansion's treasure...

Oh, that's right!...
Do you know about the telescope
at the Watch Tower?

Ah... no...
It's nothing, really...

Damn, I'm bored... Alright!
...I'm going to sulk and sleep!
entries.すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ・・・\n・・・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・・・\n\:
Zzz-zzz... gnn-ngo...
......zzz-pyo-pyo-pyo...

Mmm... the telescope is...
on the Watch Tower... on the roof...

Mumble mumble... mount it... on the pole...
...zzz-pyo-pyo-pyo...
entries.おや、かわいいボウヤだね。\nでも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・\n\nわた:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But you look healthy enough, don't you...

I may not look it, but I'm a doctor,
so if you get hurt, come again.
entries.ボウヤ・・・\nわたしゃこう見えても\nいそがしいんだよ・・・:
Boy...
I know I don't look it,
but I'm busy...
entries.みんなを助けてくれたんだって?\nけっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね:
You helped everyone, didn't you?
You're pretty good at this... Thanks.
entries.あんたがケガしたら\nまっ先に見てあげるからね:
If you get hurt,
I'll see to you first.
entries.おや、どうしたんだいその小犬・・・\nケガしてるじゃないか!\nちょっと見せてご:
Oh, what's wrong with that puppy...
It's hurt!
Let me have a look.

..........
...This looks like it will take a while...

Boy, I'll look after this puppy for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take responsibility for it.

...Oh, what's this puppy's name?
....?
Come on... you could at least give it a name...

......Baron?... I see, Baron.
...That's a good name!
entries.しばらくしたら また、\n見に来ておくれ:
Come and see us again
in a while.
entries.おまえ、森の外出るのか?\nだったら一度、海辺行ってみるといい\n\nとてもキレ:
You're going out of the forest?
Then you should go to the beach once.

It's very beautiful... you can see a big mansion far away
...Huh? There's treasure in the mansion?

...But... to get to the mansion,
you have to be taken by boat...
entries.・・・そういえば、むかし、\n海から このむらに、魔女きたことある・・・\n\n:
...Come to think of it, long ago
the Witch came to this village from the sea...

The mysterious crystal in the forest
seems to be something the Witch left behind...
entries.おまえ、ともだち・・・\nまたあそびにこい:
You, my friend...
Come play again.
entries.おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!\n・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!:
Big brother! Big brother!
...The flowers have bloomed!
entries.そ○の◎◎の◎◎・・・◎◎に\nつな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?: The ○○ of the ○○... is connected to the ○○... Is it already the ○○?
entries.◎の◎はあ●ないよ・・・: The ◎ of the ◎ doesn't have a ●...
entries.な○まの○と・・・とても○ん◎い: Ab○ut my fri○nds... I'm very w○rried
entries.な○まの○と・・・\nと○も○ん◎い:
Ab○ut my fri○nds...
I'm very w○rried
entries.森の中、とてもあぶない\n・・・ぜったいダメ!:
It's very dangerous in the forest
...absolutely not!
entries.そこの右側の入口・・・\n長老の家につながってる\n\n・・・でも、今みんな\n:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It's connected to Elder's house.

...But everyone's busy right now...
entries.おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・\nでも、まだ かんぜんには わからない\:
Oh! You've learned a little of our language...
But I still don't understand you completely.

...If you bite one more,
you can probably learn the language...
entries.ここ、ドワーフの村\n・・・なかまいなくなって\nおおさわぎ・・・:
This is the Dwarf Village...
our friends have gone missing,
and it's a big uproar...
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\nなかま、いなくなった!\n\nいま、みんなで 森にある小:
Oh no! Oh no!
Our friends are gone!

Right now everyone has opened the hut in the forest
and the door near the village entrance,

and gone to search
Wobbly Pier and the Watch Tower...
entries.なかま、木にとりついた\nホウシにつかまって\n木にぶらさがってた・・・\n\n:
A friend was caught by a spore
that attached itself to a tree,
and was hanging from the tree...

The Spore Balls stretch when you hang from them
...very suspicious...
entries.わし・・・長老のいちばんでし: I... am the Elder's top disciple
entries.なかまのこと・・・\nとてもしんぱい:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\n何がたいへんって、\nそりゃーもーたいへん!:
Terrible! Terrible!
What's so terrible?
It's just awfully terrible!
entries.この小屋のこども、\nまだかえってこないらしい: The child in this hut hasn't come back yet.
entries.封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、\n森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの\nちょうろうがもっ:
Seal Bag?... Come to think of it,
the Elder has something called
the Forest Seal Bag...
entries.おまえ、友だち・・・\nまぁ、ゆっくりしていけ:
You, friend...
Well, make yourself at home.
entries.森で、へんなイヌ見た・・・\nおまえ見たか?:
In the forest, I saw a strange dog...
Did you see it?
entries.あのイヌ、\nケガしてたんだってな・・・: I heard that dog was injured...
entries.森の中で こども\n見なかったか?: Did you see a child in the forest?
entries.森の中にある めぐみの広場\n・・・もう行ったか?:
The Megumi Plaza in the forest
...Have you been there yet?
entries.わし・・・\nつかまえた大ドロボウ 見はってる\n\n・・・ん?どこにいるか?・:
I...
I'm watching the big thief I caught.

...Hmm? Where is he?...
...I can't tell you that...
entries.長老にはもうあったか?: Have you met the Elder yet?
entries.そう言えば・・・\n始まりの森のかみつき草にも\n花が咲くらしい・・・\n\nで:
Speaking of which...
they say flowers bloom on the Biting Grass
in the Forest of Beginnings too...

But we've never seen it...
entries.キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に\n山がある・・・でも、\nとてもキケンな山・・・:
Beyond the Mushroom Forest, to the right,
there's a mountain... but
it's a very dangerous mountain...
entries.キノコの森には、\nいろんなキノコはえてるけど\nむやみに食べない方がいい: There are various mushrooms growing in the Mushroom Forest, but you shouldn't eat them recklessly.
entries.高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?\nあそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・:
Have you seen the Watch Tower's telescope yet?
The view from there is really beautiful...
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・\nちょっとたいへん・・・:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...
entries.わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・\n◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・:
Our ◎◎, has disappeared...
◎ is better than ◎...
entries.わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・\n今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・:
Our comrades have disappeared...
It's better not to go into the forest now...
entries.わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?: Have you met our Elder yet?
entries.たき火といえば・・・\n・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・\n\nそういえば、\n:
Speaking of bonfires...
...it's baked sweet potatoes, isn't it...

Come to think of it, there's a nice smell in the forest...
entries.おやっ!\n・・・これ、くれるのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・\n\nそうだ、何か:
Oh!
...You're giving me this?
How nice...

Oh yes, I don't know what it is,
but please take this in return
entries.ケガしてるね・・・\nかわいそう・・・:
You're hurt, aren't you...
Poor thing...
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?:
Have you checked all the spore buns
hanging from the pointed trees?
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅうの中に\nなかま2人 とりこまれ:
Two friends got caught
in the spore buns
hanging from the pointed trees
entries.ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・\nとてもあやしい・・・:
The swaying Spore Balls...
very suspicious...
entries.ホウシダマがかぶさっている\n木の上のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・:
There should be two friends
up in the trees covered by Spore Balls...
entries.グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり\nつかまってた・・・:
One friend was caught
at Wobbly Pier...
entries.高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん\n・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・\n回転する板:
The Watch Tower... it's big and a pain
...hard to find our friends...
unless you use the spinning boards well...
entries.たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま\nつかまっているハズ: I think there are two companions trapped in Watch Tower.
entries.たき火といえば・・・・・・\nヤキイモだねぇ・・・:
When it comes to bonfires...
It's baked sweet potatoes, isn't it...
entries.こども・・・森から\nまだかえってこないらしい・・・: The child... it seems he hasn't returned from the forest yet...
entries.そういえば、高見ヤグラで\nこどものこえ きこえたような・・・: Come to think of it, I heard a child's voice from Watch Tower...
entries.ドワーフの長老、\nとても よろこんでる: The Elder of Dwarf is very pleased.
entries.あくしゅ してほしい・・・: I want to shake your hand...
entries.・・・うわぁっ!!!\n・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・\n\nなんだ、いつか:
...Whaa!!!
...Y-you startled me...

Oh, it's that brat from before...
W-well...
They finally let me out of here, see...

I-I didn't escape or anything...
Well, I'll be going...
entries.あれ、APボックスとかいうらしい・・・\nわしらでは ひらくこと\nできないけど:
That thing's called an AP box, I hear...
We can't open it,
though...
entries.なにか、かんじましたかな・・・\n\nおまえさんが いまかんじた\n「嵐の山の怪:
Did you feel something...?

What you just felt,
the strange presence of Storm Mountain,
is proof that this mountain
has been put under a spell.

...Further on, too, if you feel something
in a new place,
that place has been put under a spell...

In other words,
it's where a Seal Bag is hidden...

Spotting the places under the spell
is the key to finding the Seal Bags...
entries.・・・おっ・・・ぬけ穴が見えた\n・・・ありがてぇ・・・これでやっと\nぬけだせ:
...Oh... I can see the escape hole
...Great... now I can finally
get out... So long!
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・ん?\n何の見はりか?\n・・・・・それはおしえられない:
I... watch... hmm?
What kind of watch?
...I can't tell you that.
entries.ケガを早く治すのに「ナオリ草」があれば\nいいんだけど・・・\n\nあれがあるの:
I wish I had some Naori Herb
to heal an injury quickly...

I think that grows on Great Bird Mountain,
if I remember right...

But
it's windy and dangerous there...
entries.あらっ! ナオリ草じゃないか\n\nあんた 大トリの山まで 取りに行ったのかい!:
Oh my! Isn't that Naori Herb!

You went all the way to Great Bird Mountain to get it!?
It's lucky you came back safe.

But with this, Baron's injury will heal quickly.
entries.あとは おいしいものでも たべさせて\nゆっくりしとけば 元気になるさ・・・\n:
After that, if you feed it something tasty
and let it rest, it'll perk up...

Oh, speaking of tasty things — the "Knowledge Fruit"!
I ate one a long time ago,
and it was delicious.

I'd love to eat it again...
entries.まぁ! これは百識の木の実じゃないか\nあたしにくれるのかい?\n\n・・・・え:
My! Isn't this the Knowledge Fruit?
Are you giving it to me?

...Eh!? To Baron?...
Well, of course.
We have to get Baron well first.

Here you go, Baron!
Eat this and get well...
entries.ところで このごろ\nバロンを見てて思うんだけど\n\nこのバロンは\nなんか:
By the way, lately, watching Baron, I've been thinking...

Doesn't this Baron
have some kind of mysterious power?

Look, his ears are this big, aren't they?
Maybe he could fly with them...

I mean, just as an example!
But watching Baron,
it does make me feel that way.

Well, for now the main thing is to get well quickly.
After that, we'll see what fun's in store.
entries.とにかく これで だいじょうぶ\nあとはあたしに まかせておきな\n\nまた ち:
Anyway, he'll be fine now.
Leave the rest to me.

Come show your face again now and then.

Baron will be glad too...
entries.そうそう あんた\n始まりの村にある屋敷のウラの\n浜辺に行くことあるかい?\n:
Oh, by the way, do you ever go to the beach behind the mansion in the Village of Beginnings?

Every year at this time, seaweed always gets washed up there by the waves,

and this seaweed is good for you. It keeps you from getting sick.

I want everyone to stay healthy, so I go to get it every year,

but this year it looks like I can't. If you happen to go there, could you pick some up for me?
entries.ねェ それはそうと\nバロン 少しおおきくなったように\n思わないかい?\n\n:
Say, by the way,
don't you think Baron's gotten a little bigger?

Is he growing fast,
or am I imagining it...
entries.ありがとう\nこれで今年もみんな元気ですごせるよ\n\nところで ごらん、バロン:
Thank you,
now everyone will stay healthy this year too.

Now look, Baron —
you've grown this big!
He really grows fast.

When you brought him in,
he was very weak,

but he's grown this big,
so he's fine now!
entries.あらっ?!\nバロンはあんたといっしょに行きたい\nみたいだねェ\n\nつれてっ:
Oh?!
It looks like Baron wants to go with you.

Take him along.
entries.なんか 背中にのれって言ってるよ\nのってあげな\nバロンも うれしいんだよ\n:
He seems to be saying to get on his back.
Go ahead and ride.
Baron will be happy too.

Well, see you again.
If you get hurt, come back.

I'll heal you, so
you two take care.
entries.でも あんたこれを わざわざ\nもって来てやったのかい?\n\nナオリ草も百識の:
But did you bring this all the way here?

It must have been tough to find both Naori Herb and Knowledge Fruit...

Baron seems to understand very well. Baron really looks happy when you come.
entries.ドワーフの森・・・\nもとに もどった!:
The Dwarf Forest...
is back to normal!
entries.やっと、百花の森・・・\nなまえどおりになった・・・\nみんな、おまえのおかげ!:
At last, the Forest of a Hundred Flowers...
has become what its name says...
It's all thanks to you!
entries.トンバ、魔ブタやっつけた?\n・・・ありがとう\n・・・ほんとうに ありがとう・:
Tomba, did you beat the Evil Pigs?
...Thank you
...Really, thank you...
entries.ほかの魔ブタも やっつけたか?\n・・・あまりムリするな・・・:
Did you defeat the other Evil Pigs too?
...Don't push yourself too hard...
entries.・・・も?・・・森の地下に\nひとがすんでるのか?\n・・・・・・びっくり:
...Also?...
People live under the forest?
......What a surprise
entries.おまえさんには 何と礼を言っていいのか・・・\nあたまが 下がる思いですじゃ・・:
I don't know how to thank you...
I bow my head to you...
entries.・・・なに?\nトンバ、こまってるのか?\n\n・・・わしとおまえ ともだち・・:
...What?
Is Tomba in trouble?

...You and I are friends...
I'll be right behind you!
entries.よぉ・・・\nお前のくるのを\nまってたんだ・・・\n\nどうだい? オレと\n:
Hey...
I've been waiting
for you to come...

How about it?
Want to have a match with me?

The truth is, I hid a treasure
at the top of the Watch Tower
up ahead.

Here's the deal: start from the bottom
of the Watch Tower, and if you reach
the treasure before I do...

the treasure is yours.
How about it, sounds fun, right?
Well... here I go!
entries.ケガでもしたら\nいつでも おいで\nあたしが治してあげるから:
If you get hurt,
come see me any time.
I'll heal you.
entries.おやっ ケガしてるじゃないか\nみせてごらん 治してあげるから:
Oh my, you're hurt!
Let me see — I'll heal you.
entries.私は、人のけいけんの\nレベルをつたえる占い師の一人です:
I am one of the fortune tellers
who tell people their experience level
entries.私は 500000APの\nけいけんを持っている方にしか\nお話しできません・・:
I can only speak with someone
who has 500000 AP of experience...
entries.・・・あなたの けいけんは\n十分なようですね・・・\nそれでは 見てみましょう:
...Your experience seems sufficient...
Then let us take a look...

Hmm...

...Navy is the Door on the Beach...

...Orange is the Jungle...

...Yellow is the Keeper of Time...

The remaining blue is...
......here.
...Somewhere in this Underground Maze...

...First, please visit the 100-Million-Year-Old Man.
...Your battle...
...is only now beginning...

...From us fortune tellers, this...
entries.おれ・・・\nこの先に 穴を掘りに行ったんだけど・・・\n\nなぁ〜んか\nきみ:
I...
went to dig a hole up ahead, but...

It was a creepy room, somehow...
entries.おれの つれがさぁ・・・\nやめとけって言ったのに・・・\nおくに入っていったん:
My buddy...
I told him to stop...
but he went in deeper...
entries.よぉ、・・・億年老人には もう会ったかい?: Hey… have you met the 100-Million-Year-Old Man yet?
entries.おっ?・・・\n人がたずねてくるなんて めずらしいな・・・\n\nそこの 開かな:
Huh? ...
It's rare for someone to come asking...

Have you seen that door that won't open yet?
entries.・・・どうやら、この地下迷宮にあるトビラは\nそのむかし かくした宝を守るために:
...Apparently the doors in this Underground Maze
were made by thieves long ago
to guard hidden treasure...

So I doubt you could open them with an ordinary key...

...Let me think...
You'd probably open them with something
thieves often use, some kind of tool...

Come to think of it...
a while ago a thief I know

said something about dropping an important wire
in Karakuri Village or whatever...
entries.・・・そうかぁ・・・\nトビラはハリガネで開くのかぁ・・・\n\nでも、よく水の:
...I see...
So the door opens with a wire...

But you did well to find it in the water...
entries.ヨイショ!ヨイショ!\n・・・・・・ふぅーーーっ・・・\n\nおれたちにとって:
Heave-ho! Heave-ho!
......Phew...

Digging holes is what we live for,
but these walls here...
are pretty tough...

Damn it, just you wait!
I'll definitely cut through
this buried path!!
entries.オラオラオラオラオラァッ!!\nはなれてなっ!\nおれに近寄るとケガするぜっ!!:
Hey hey hey hey hey!!
Stand back!
Get near me and you'll get hurt!!
entries.うわぁ!\n・・・・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・\n\nなんだ?\nあんた どーやっ:
Whoa!
......You startled me...

What?
How did you get in here?

...Huh? A wire?
...And it broke?

...I see, you're in trouble...

Um... so what you need
is a wire that won't break,
right......
entries.う〜ん・・・そうだっ!\n盗賊の道具だったら シーフマンションに\nあるかも し:
Hmm... I know!
If it's a thief's tool,
it might be in Thief Mansion!

...One of our buddies
should be at Thief Mansion right now...
Find him and ask...
entries.なんだ・・・おれっちに 何かようか?\n・・・・・・?\n\n・・・ハリガネ?\:
What... did you want something from me?
......?

...A wire?
...A sturdy wire that won't break?

...Hahaha...
What are the odds I'd have something that handy...

...Well, I do, as it happens...

But I went through a lot to get it...
Well, I just picked it up here a minute ago, though...

.........

Alright, alright! Fine!
You can have it!

...So please don't look at me like that...
entries.この地下迷宮の中にも\nうらないしが いるらしいな・・・\n\nおれは 会ったこ:
There's supposedly a fortune teller
somewhere in this Underground Maze too...

I've never met him,
but I bet it takes an AP total
that makes your eyes pop out...
entries.なんだ?\nその古びた車を動かしたいのか?\n\nそれには水が必要なんだ・・・\:
What?
You want to get that old car moving?

It needs water...
But not just any ordinary water.

Um... I can't remember,
but I'm pretty sure I heard it ran on burning water...
entries.な、水で動いただろう?\nいつか おれも のせてくれよな!:
See, it ran on water, didn't it?
Give me a ride sometime!
entries.おれたちは\nロマンをもとめて 穴をほるのさ・・・\n\nなんでも\nこの地下に:
We dig holes in search of romance...

Apparently, there's a legendary treasure vault hidden in this underground.
entries.言い伝えだと・・・\n宝物庫へ行くには\n仕掛けをクリアしないとダメらしい・・・:
The legend says...
to get to the treasure vault,
you have to clear some kind of trick...

But me, I'm going to dig my way
right into the vault!

Hm... how to solve the trick?

Take a look at the graffiti on the rocks
left by whoever made the trick.

There should be six of them above ground,
so finding them might help...
entries.さぁ! べつの場所を掘ってみるかな・・・: Alright! Maybe I'll try digging up a different place...
entries.おおぉぉ!\n・・・ついに\nここまで たどりついたか・・・\n\n・・・・・・:
Ohhh!
...So you've finally made it this far...

......I see...
100 years... 1,000 years... 10,000 years...

The old men of every age
must surely be backing you...

Such a lovely...
...such clear eyes you have...

...If it's you, perhaps...
...Yes, such innocent eyes
make one think so...

......Now then...
...About the Evil Pigs...
Why are they collecting gold...?

It is because the source of their magic
is gold.

In other words...
they want stronger magic,
and so they gather gold so desperately.

It has long been said
that monsters dwell in gold...
......But...

To leave the Evil Pigs as they are forever
would be very dangerous...
entries.このままでは・・・\n集められる 黄金の力をかりて\nより強力な魔法を身につける:
At this rate...
they will borrow the power of the gold they gather
and acquire even stronger magic...

Before that happens...
we must seal the Evil Pigs by any means...

First... with the Seal Bags you carry,
seal the Evil Pigs you are able to find,
one by one,
surely...

...According to the 10,000-Year-Old Man,
you have already visited all seven lands
that the Evil Pigs put under their spell...

In that case, you have all but obtained
the seven Seal Bags already......

If a Seal Bag is missing...
it must be somewhere
in the lands you have adventured through so far...

...Now then, take this...
...It is the 100-Million-Year Key.

The Chests of Time are hidden everywhere...
Take care not to miss any...
entries.・・・七匹の魔ブタが全て封印されること・・・\nそれが わたしの せつなる願いで:
...For all seven Evil Pigs to be sealed...
that is my earnest wish...
entries.こっ!・・・これは!?・・・・・・\n\nなぜじゃっ!\n・・・魔ブタは たしか:
Th-this is...!?......

Why!?
...I was sure we'd sealed all seven Evil Pigs......

......A new Seal Bag and Evil Pig Gate...
.........Surely not!

...Stay calm and listen......
I thought it was only a rumor myself, but...

......It seems there is one more new Evil Pig hiding...

Most likely it was the one pulling the strings
of the seven Evil Pigs until now from the shadows......
The true Evil Pig......

......But we have the Seal Bag,
and the door is right before us......
Let's go straight through now......
entries.おおっ・・・\n・・・なんということだ・・・・・・\n\nやはり 力無きものは・:
Ohh...
...What a thing...

As expected, those without strength
must follow the strong...

......Hm?... What is this...?
......Hm-hm......
This seems to be some kind of mechanism...

...Now that the Evil Pig that stood on this pedestal
is gone, the door has closed......

If so...
someone just has to stand
on these seven pedestals again......

Then the door should open again...
entries.そうか! 友達か!\n\n・・・・・・友達を7人\nつれてくるんじゃな・・・・・:
I see! Friends, then!

......So you'll bring seven friends with you...
entries.よしっ!\n・・・わしは あなたがもどってくるまで\nここで待っているから・・・:
All right!
...I'll wait here until you come back...

Tell your friends to come straight here.
I'll explain the rest...

If you really can't gather them all,
come back here once...
...I'm counting on you......
entries.おおっ! そうじゃ・・・思い出したっ!・・・\nあなたに こいつを あずけておき:
Oh! That's right... I remember now!...
I'll leave this one with you...

Well?
Do you remember...?

This is the puppy you saved
in the Dwarf Forest......

Its injuries haven't fully healed yet,
so listen carefully to what the dwarf
who first took care of it tells you.....

Baron has a mysterious power...

If you use Baron on the item screen,
he has the same effect
as the Megumi Wings......

Now, Baron... off you go...

Oh! That's right... I remember now!...
I'll leave this one with you...

This one is called Baron......
He was hurt in the Dwarf Forest,
so I've been raising him...

He's sure to be a help to you...
Think of him as a friend and treasure him...

Baron has a mysterious power...

If you use Baron on the item screen,
he has the same effect
as the Megumi Wings......

Now, Baron... off you go...
entries.・・・・・・そうか\n・・・どうしても ひとり足りんか・・・・・・\nこまったの:
......I see
...so one is still missing......
What a bother...
entries.バロン!?・・・・・・\nそうか・・・\n\nバロンもトンバにとっては\nりっぱ:
Baron!?...
I see...

Baron is also a splendid friend to Tomba...
entries.おお・・・トンバ!・・・\nあれから、何とかトビラを固定してのぉ・・・\n\nこ:
Oh... Tomba!...
I managed to fix the door in place since then...

Now you can go through the gate
any time you like
entries.どこかで 何かが動く音がした・・・: I heard the sound of something moving somewhere...
entries.フフフ・・・フハハハハハ・・・・・・\n\nこの、トビラの中に\n入れるわけには:
Heh heh heh... Hwa-ha-ha-ha-ha......

I can't let you in through this door...

Go ahead and fume out there as much as you like...

Ha ha ha... Haaa-ha-ha-ha......
entries.風の谷\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
The Valley of the Wind

Save?
Yes → △ No → ×
entries.ぎょうむ連絡 トンバ様へ\nもし、大トリの山などでお困りのことがありま:
Official Notice to Tomba
If you run into any trouble on Great Bird Mountain or elsewhere,
please feel free to ask the nearest villager.

We will help your journey as much as we can.
Have a good trip.
......Everyone in Bacchus Village

P.S.... There may be cases where we cannot meet your expectations,
so please understand in advance.
entries.大トリの巣\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
Great Bird's Nest

Save?
Yes → △ No → ×
entries.・・・なんだい?\nおれは今いそがしいんだ・・・:
...What is it?
I'm busy right now...
entries.ん?・・・何をしてるかって?\n・・・見りゃわかるだろ、\nトンネルをほってるの:
Hm?... What am I doing?
...Can't you tell?
I'm digging a tunnel... Well,

not to brag, but when it comes to digging holes,
nobody beats me...
entries.・・・よせよ、そんなにほめると\n・・・てれるじゃねーか・・・\n\nま、このト:
...Cut it out, you'll embarrass me
with all that praise...

Well, once this tunnel is finished,
I'll be off again,

digging another hole somewhere,
so say hi if you see me...
entries.だからオレは\nやめとこうって言ったんだよ:
That's why I said
we should've stopped
entries.いまさら言っても\nしょうがないだろ・・・: It's too late to say that now...
entries.だいたいお前がジャングルに\n行きたいなんて言うから・・・: It's because you said you wanted to go to the Jungle…
entries.だってさぁ、この山にいる\n大トリにのれば、\n\nジャングルにつれていって\n:
Well, I heard that if you ride
the Great Bird on this mountain,

it'll take you to the jungle
entries.なにが大トリだよ、あのトリが\n空の主ってよばれてたのは\n昔のはなしだぞ・・・:
What Great Bird?
That bird being called Lord of the Sky
was ages ago...
entries.へ・・・へ・・・\nへ〜くしょいぃぃったらほんま!!\n\nだめだ・・・このまま:
A... a...
Aaah-choo, dammit!!

This is bad... at this rate
I'll catch a cold...
entries.おいっ、まてよ!・・・\nまったくあわて者だな・・・お〜い!:
Hey, wait up!...
What a hasty guy... Heeey!
entries.おい、お前さん、悪いことは言わんから\n今すぐ山をおりた方がいいぞ:
Hey, kid, I'm not saying this to be mean,
but you'd better get off the mountain right now
entries.・・・あんちゃん、\n大トリに 用があるってことは\nジャングルに行きたいのかい:
...Hey, pal, if you've got business with the Great Bird,
do you want to go to the jungle?

...Hmmm...
I'd better not if I were you.

...True, the Great Bird will take you to the jungle, but...

that's from when it was healthy...
Now, because of this storm,
it can't even eat and is wobbling around...

I don't know where it'll drop you...
entries.よお、あんちゃん\nやっぱり落とされたんだってな\n\n・・・しかし、落ちたのが:
Hey, pal.
So you did get dropped after all.

...Funny, though, that you landed
in our village.

...Hm?... Oh, the Great Bird?
Looks like it went back
to its nest up above.

...If you've got the nerve to get through the Lava Cave,
go on and try.

But!
Without the legendary tool... the Grapple,
I don't think you'll get there...
entries.なにか、かんじましたかな・・・おまえさんが\nいまかんじた「嵐の山の怪」こそ、\:
Did you feel something...?
What you just felt, the strange presence of Storm Mountain,
is proof that this mountain has been put under a spell.

...Further on, too, if you feel something in a new place,
that place has been put under a spell...

In other words, it is where a Seal Bag is hidden...
Spotting the places under the spell
is the key to finding the Seal Bags...
entries.・・・ん? こんなところで\n何をしてるかって?\n・・・見はってるんだよ\n\:
...Hm? What am I doing in a place like this?
...I'm keeping watch.

...Truth is, there's a 1,000-Year Treasure Chest
placed down below...

Apparently there's something important inside...

I was asked to keep watch until someone
with the 1,000-Year Key shows up...

That old man looked after me,
so I have to repay him at a time like this...
entries.・・・ん?・・・んおおぉぉっ!\nそっ、それは 1000年のカギ!!\n\nそう:
...Hm?... Whoaaa!
T-that's the 1,000-Year Key!!

I see... so someone worthy of that key
has finally shown up...

...Looks like my job is done...

Oh, and I don't know what it is, but whatever's in that box...
take good care of it!
entries.ここなら だいじょうぶだと\nおもったんだけどなぁ・・・\nつぎは むずかしいぞ:
I thought this place would be safe...
The next spot will be harder!
entries.ん? とうさんからの べんとう?\nそうか・・・だれも見つけられないから\nずい:
Hm? A lunch box from Dad?
I see... nobody could find me,
so I'd been hiding for ages...

As thanks for bringing it,
you eat the lunch box.
And I don't need this, so you can have it too.
See ya!!
entries.どうしたの?\n\n・・・とうさんから あずかった \nべんとう食べたの・・・\:
What's wrong?

...You ate the lunch box
you were given by Dad?

Ha ha ha, don't worry about it.
I'm not hungry anyway.

Well, I'm off now.
...Take care!
entries.やぁ!またあったな・・・\nどうだい、このパラソル\n・・・なかなかオシャレだろ:
Hey! We meet again...
How do you like this parasol?
...Pretty stylish, huh?
entries.ん〜・・・・・・\nウマイ!・・・でも、\nまだものたりないなぁ・・・:
Hmm......
Delicious!... But
it's still not enough...
entries.え?もう1本くれるのか?\n・・・よぉし!やくそく通り\nこのパラソルはお前にや:
Huh? You're giving me another one?
...All right! As promised,
this parasol is yours!
entries.コイツをうまく使えば、\n高いところからとびおりても、\nゆっくりおりれるゾ・・:
If you use this well,
you can jump down from high places
and float down slowly...
entries.サンキュー 助かったぜ\nひどいとこだな ここは・・・\n\n風にとばされて ひ:
Thanks, you saved me.
What a terrible place this is...

I got blown away by the wind and got stuck.
For a while I wondered what would happen...

Huh!?
My pants are ripped!!
......Hmm
entries.ひどいとこだな ここは・・・\n風にとばされて ひっかかっちゃってサ\n一時は:
What a terrible place this is...
I got blown away by the wind and got stuck.
For a while I wondered what would happen...

Huh!?
My pants are ripped!!
......Hmm
entries.・・・じつは ここに来て 替えのパンツ\nなくしちゃってサァ\n\nどーしよう・:
...Actually, I lost my spare pants
after I came here

What do I do... It's too embarrassing,
I can't move from here
entries.アッ!! それっ!!\nどこに あったんだ?\n見つけてくれたのか?\n\nサン:
Ah!! That's it!!
Where did you find it?
Did you find it for me?

Thank you, now I can move from here.
entries.そうだ!\nお礼に これやるョ:
That's right!
I'll give you this as a thank you.
entries.つかい方は・・・\n「ウッキーパラソル」つかうで そうびしたら\nジャンプすると:
How to use it...
Equip the Ukki Parasol,
and it opens by itself when you jump.

That slows your fall.
You can also come down faster with the ↓ direction key.

You can ride the wind with it too,
so use it well. Got it?
Well, see you.
entries.ここまで 来ては みたものの\n炎がすごくて 行けそうにないんだ: I came this far, but the flames are so intense I don't think I can go any further.
entries.ここまで 来んのは ひと苦労だったのに\n・・・そうだっ!\n\nおまえ この炎:
It was a lot of work to get this far...
...I know!

You, put out this fire for me!!
...Just kidding, just kidding.

There's no way you could do that...
entries.あーあ 雨でもふりゃぁ\n消えるかもしれないけど\nどうくつの中じゃぁな・・・:
Ah, if only it would rain,
it might go out,
but inside a cave...
entries.ところで こんなの 見つけたんだけど\nだれのかな?\n\nどっちにしろ オレに:
By the way, I found this, but who's it for?

Either way, I don't need it, so I'll give it to you.
entries.なんで おれが\nここに いることができたのか\n・・・ふしぎか?\n\nマグマ:
How can I be here?
...Strange, isn't it?

In the Lava Cave,
this is the only spot that shields you from the heat...

...Never mind that,
it doesn't matter...
entries.おれは今 悩んじゃってねェ・・・\nその悩みというのがさ・・・\nだれにも言うな:
I'm in a real bind right now...
And the bind is...
don't tell anyone!

The truth is...
I lost something important
the Boss entrusted me with...

Don't tell! Absolutely!!
I have a feeling I lost it around here,
so I came to look, but...

It's hot, and it's dangerous...
I can't search.
What am I gonna do...
entries.みつけることが あったら\nおしえてくれや よろしくな・・・\nハ〜ァ・・・・・:
If you ever find it,
let me know, please...
Haaah......
entries.ゲッ!\nどどどどどど どこにあったんだ?\nこれっ これなんだわ\n\nありが:
Gah!
W-w-w-where was it?
That's it, that's it!

Thank you, I don't know
how to thank you...
entries.これで カシラにも\nしかられずにすむわ\n\nよかった よかった・・・\nこれ:
Now the Boss won't
have to scold me

Thank goodness...
Now I can go back
to the Boss, too

Save?
Yes → △ No → ×
entries.いやぁ、たすかったよ・・・\nオレは中央センターの者なんだけど、\n自分で湖まで:
Boy, you saved me...
I'm from the Central Center,
and I tried to go to the lake myself, and look at me.

...Jeez...
and I even brought the key to the small room...

...It's pathetic, but
I'm going back to the village for now...

Oh, if there's anything you don't understand,
come find me...
I'll be at the Central Center.

Don't push yourself too hard either...
entries.・・・なぁ、これ 何だとおもう?\n・・・何かフシギな絵だよなぁ\n\nなんか:
...Hey, what do you think this is?
...It's some kind of strange picture, isn't it?

It looks like it's sunken in, but... maybe it's something to be inserted...?

...Come to think of it, I think there was a door with a large keyhole somewhere in this building.

...I wonder if there's a connection...?
entries.・・・よく来た・・・と、\n言いたいところじゃが、\n\n見ての通り、とても話が:
...I'd like to say "welcome," but...

as you can see, I'm in no state to talk...

Well, I did get in their way quite a bit.

Those Koma Buta shut me up in this place...
So you see,

unless I take away the magic power of whatever seals this room,
I can't get out of here...
entries.すまんが、\nこの部屋の封印がとけてから、\nまた来てくれんか・・・:
Sorry,
but could you come again
after the seal on this room is broken...
entries.おお、来たか・・・サスガじゃな、\n100年のヤツが言っておったことも\nまんざ:
Oh, you've come... Impressive.
What the 100-Year-Old Man said
seems to be not entirely a lie...

Hm... You want to hear about the Evil Pigs...
The Evil Pigs use very strong magic...
strong enough to change the areas they rule.

...But to produce such strong magic,
they need a great deal of gold...
yes, gold.

They seem to be gathering it somewhere.

...If you can find that place,
the keepsake bracelet you're looking for
is sure to turn up too...
entries.フム・・・・・・・・・\nおぬしはまだまだ強くなる・・・\nその探求心をなくさん:
Hm.........
You'll grow stronger still...
so long as you don't lose that spirit of inquiry...

First, try climbing the Sun's Holy Flame Stand,
which is somewhere in this building...

A new path will open from there...
Find the rest by your own strength.
entries.・・・ホレ、わしからのプレゼント\n・・・1000年のカギじゃ・・・: ...Here, a gift from me... It's the 1,000-Year Key...
entries.1000年カギで あけることができる\n1000年の宝箱には大トリの山の先・・・:
What the 1,000-Year Key opens,
the 1,000-Year Treasure Chest, is beyond Great Bird Mountain...

That is, it holds what you need
to get through the Lava Cave...

I believe... it should be placed on Great Bird Mountain.

But... crossing the cave takes technique...
And then there are those flames in the Lava Cave...

For those, there is nothing to be done
unless you find and seal the Evil Pig
that cast the magic there.

If you have the Green Seal Bag,
you should be able to find the Evil Pig Gate,
so search this building well...
entries.気を付けて行くんじゃぞ・・・\nそうじゃ・・・もう一度、大トリにのりたいのなら\:
Be careful when you go...
That's right... If you want to ride the Great Bird again,
try looking for the Great Bird's favorite...

I believe it was called the So-and-so Flower...
Well then... take care...
entries.ふぅ、なんとか たどりついたな\n・・・おれはここで待ってるから、\nよろしくな:
Phew, I finally made it here... I'll be waiting here, so take care.

Ah... Also, the pump switch might be broken, so please make sure to turn it on properly.
entries.すまないな・・・\nおれたちのちからでは\nうごかないんだ・・・:
I'm sorry...
Our power won't move it...
entries.どうやら、なおったみたいだな・・・\nさぁ、いっしょにかえろうか・・・:
It seems like it's fixed...
Well, let's go home together...
entries.・・・ちょっとカンタンすぎたかな?\n・・・じゃあ、またな!:
...Was it a bit too easy?
...Well, see you later!
entries.そのべんとうは・・・とうさんに会ったんだね?\nわざわざ とどけてくれてありがと:
That lunch box... you met Dad, didn't you?
Thanks for going out of your way to bring it,
but you can have it.

I'm not hungry, so
take this too, if you like.
It's nothing much, though...

Well then, bye!
entries.え・・・な、なんだって!!\nオイラのべんとう 食べちゃったのか?\n\nオイオ:
Eh... what?!
Did you eat my lunch box?!

Hey hey, it's just a joke...
You don't have to worry about it!
Dad's lunch box is delicious anyway!

Well then, I'm off... Bye-bye!
entries.いや〜じつはさぁ・・・また\nなくしちゃったんだわ・・・\n\nカシラに見つかる:
Well, the thing is... I lost it again...

I'm hiding here because it'd be bad
if the Boss found me,

and I seem to have left it
back where I was before.

But if I go down now,
the Boss will find me,
so I can't go down...

What am I gonna do...
entries.いやーさっきといい 今といい\nほんっとに ありがとう: Wow, just like before and now, thank you so much!
entries.お礼といったら なんなんだが\nこれもらってくれや:
As a thank-you,
please take this
entries.今のうちに これ\nカシラに返しとくわ\nそれっ!:
I'll give this back
to the Boss while I can!
Here goes!
entries.はぁ・・・こまったわねぇ・・・\nあんな滝のうえに あるなんて・・・\n\nどう:
Haa... I'm in trouble...
To be on top of such a waterfall...

What should I do... my necklace...
entries.・・・あらっ?・・・これは?\n・・・わたしの首飾り!\n\n・・・ひょっとして:
...Oh? ...What is this?
...My necklace!

...Could it be that you brought it for me? ...I'm so happy!
entries.・・・えっ? 水の潜り方をおしえてほしい?\n・・・わかったわ わたしにまかせて:
...Huh? You want me to teach you how to dive?
...All right, leave it to me!

...I happen to have left something
under this water...

If you can get it,
you'll have diving down perfectly...
entries.まずは、水に入ってちょうだい: First, please get into the water.
entries.そうそう・・・そうやってると\n体が水に浮くでしょ・・・\n\nで、そこから潜る:
Oh yeah... if you do that, your body will float in the water...

And then, diving from there isn't that difficult...

First... try pressing the direction key down...
entries.方向キーを下に押して\nあたまを下にむけるの: Press the directional pad down to turn your head downward.
entries.そう・・・そのちょうし・・・あとは\n行きたい方向のキーと□ボタンで\n水中を進:
That's it... just like that... After that,
you can swim through the water
with the key for the direction you want and the □ button.

Now do your best
to fetch the thing I left.
entries.どう?\nもう水中の潜りは\nカンペキでしょ?:
How about it?
Isn't diving underwater perfect now?
entries.・・・せっかく取ってきたんだから\nその万能魚のエサは あなたにあげるわ\n\n:
...Since I went through the trouble of getting it, I'll give you that Almighty Fish bait.

...I don't really know either...

Apparently, if you use that bait in a place with water, the Almighty Fish might appear...
entries.なんだ・・・おれっちに 何かようか?\n\n・・・・・・?・・・ハリガネ?\n・:
What... did you want something from me?

......?... A wire?
...A sturdy wire that won't break?

...Hahaha...
What are the odds I'd have something that handy...

...Well, I do, as it happens...

But I went through a lot to get it...
Well, I just picked it up here a minute ago, though...

.........All right!
Fine! You can have it!...

...So please don't look at me like that...
entries.魔ブタ・・・黄金・・・!!\nいくいくっ!・・・・・・\n\nでも、魔ブタはこわ:
Evil Pigs... gold...!!
I'm in! I'm in!......

But the Evil Pigs are scary...
But I'm going!!
entries.わぁっはっは!\nいやぁ!ひさしぶりだなぁ!\n\nえぇ〜っと・・・\n・・・・:
Wa-ha-ha!
Well, well! Long time no see!

Um...
......who are you again?

Huh?... We've never met?...
I see, I see......

So? What do you want?...
...My precious thing?...

Gah-ha-ha!
Then it's fine!

After all, I've left it with
the subordinate I trust most!

Wa-ha-ha!
Well, well! Long time no see!

Um...
......who are you again?

Huh?... My precious thing?

...Oh, yes, you did give it back to me...
...Want me to show you?

...Um...
...Let me see...

......Dwa-ha-ha!...
...I lost it!

And I've forgotten
what was inside, too!...

...And me with such a good memory...
Oh, boy!

...Well, whatever!
It's probably around here somewhere,
so if you find it, it's yours!...

If I could forget it,
it probably wasn't anything much anyway.

Take it, thief!...
...Oh!...

Am I the thief?
Wa-ha-ha!
entries.いやぁ・・・長かったなぁ\n\nおれたちが\nここを追い出されてどれくらいかなぁ:
Boy... that took a long time.

How long has it been
since we were thrown out of here?

I miss it.
entries.あぁ? 人魚だぁ?\n\n・・・そう言えば・・・だれかが\nこのマンションのどっ:
Huh? A mermaid?

...Come to think of it... someone said
they saw one somewhere in this mansion...
entries.ドロボウが\n自分たちの すみかを取られてちゃあ\n話しにならんよなぁ・・・:
A thief having his own lair taken
is a joke, isn't it...
entries.やっぱり、じぶんの家が\nいちばんだな・・・\n\nまったく、トンバさまさまだよ:
After all, your own house
is the best...

Honestly, thank goodness for Tomba...
entries.ああ、人魚かい?・・・\nえ〜っと たしか・・・\n\n上のほうの部屋に\nいた:
Ah, Mermaid, huh?...
Um... I think...

I think she was in the room upstairs...
entries.よおっ! おまえか?\n\nここに魔法をかけてた魔ブタを\nやっつけたのは・・・:
Whoa! Is that you?

The one who defeated the Evil Pig that was casting magic here… thank you!
entries.ハリガネ?・・・\nまぁ、むかしは使ってたからな・・・\n\nどっかに 一つぐら:
Wire?...
Well, I used to use it back then...

There should be at least one
left somewhere.
entries.フンフフン・・・\nおっと、いけねぇ・・・\n\n思わず はなうた\nうたっちま:
Hmm-hm-hmm...
Oops, shouldn't...

I hummed
without thinking...
entries.何か 探してるのかい?・・・\n\nそういやあ\n穴掘り名人が何か見つけたとか\:
Are you looking for something? ...

Oh yeah, I heard the master of digging holes was excited about finding something...
entries.・・・やっと きたか・・・\n\nおれたちからの お礼に\nイイモノやるよ・・・:
...You're finally here...

We'll give you something good
as thanks...

Not that we do it every time, mind you
entries.ちいさなカギのドア: The Door with the Small Key
entries.大きなカギの絵?: A picture of a big key?
entries.バッカスの村\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
Village of Bacchus

Save?
Yes → △ No → ×
entries.よく当たる赤の占い師のいえ\n 今なら無料\nダイナミックキャンペーン中!:
House of the Red Fortune Teller
Our readings often hit the mark!
Free for now —
Dynamic Campaign underway!
entries.・・・かんばんの上にはり紙がしてある: ...A flyer is posted on the signboard
entries.迷子ネズミのお知らせ\n本物の子ネズミが迷子になっています\n\nみなさんのよう:
Notice: Lost Mouse
A real baby mouse has gone missing.

It is not a former human like all of you,
so it must be taken into protection quickly.

Anyone who finds it,
please contact the Central Center first.

We will come to pick it up.
We ask for everyone's cooperation.
Bacchus Village · Central Center
entries.お知らせ\n皆さんのご協力のおかげで、\n子ネズミは ぶじに見つかりました\n\:
Notice
Thanks to everyone's cooperation,
the baby mouse has been found safe.

Thank you very much.
Bacchus Village · Central Center
entries.おねがい\n湖のポンプがこわれているため、\n村のおサケがたりません\:
Request
The pump at the lake is broken,
so the village is running short of sake.

Would someone go to Lake Bacchus
and fix the pump?

We're waiting for brave challengers
who aren't afraid of Thief Mansion.
Bacchus Village · Central Center
entries.何かご用ですか?: What can I help you with?
entries.ん?・・・おおっ!・・・\nどこかで会ったような気がするけど\n・・・だれだっけ:
Hmm? ... Oh! ...
I feel like I've seen you somewhere before... but who was it?
entries.おや?・・・\nどこかで見たかおだと思ったら、\nお前さんは たしかあの時の・・:
Huh? ...
I thought I'd seen you somewhere before, but you're definitely that guy from back then...
entries.ん?・・・おおっ!\n大トリの山で会った少年じゃないか\n・・・よくぶじだったな:
Hm?... Oh!
Aren't you the boy I met on Great Bird Mountain?
...You made it through safe, I see.
entries.おいおい、何いってるんだ、\nキノコの森の怪物を\nたいじしたのはその子だぞ:
Hey, what are you saying?
This kid is the one who took care of
the monster in the Mushroom Forest
entries.はぁーーーっ\n・・・たいしたもんだ、\nまだちっこいのになぁ・・・: Wow... that's impressive, even though he's still so little...
entries.・・・そうだ、キノコの森の怪物もいなくなったことだし\n・・・ついでと言っちゃあ:
...Oh, right, now that the Mushroom Forest monster is gone...
...while we're at it,
could I ask you to do one more job?

The thing is, there's something called the Reaper Fruit in the Mushroom Forest,
and the trouble is, if you leave this fruit alone,
all the other plants wither...
entries.だからあんたに、その死神の実を\n全部つぶしてもらいたいんだ:
So I'd like you to crush
all of those Reaper Fruits.
entries.・・・そうだ、これをもっていきな!\n死神の実の除草剤だ・・・\nこれがないと死:
...That's right, take this with you!
It's the weed killer for Reaper Fruit...
You can't harvest Reaper Fruit without this.
entries.俺たちのしらべでは全部で\n5個ぐらいだと思うんだが・・・\nがんばって ぜんぶ:
By our count there are about five
in all...
Do your best to crush them all!
entries.死神の実にはカオみたいな\nもようがついてるから\nまちがえないようにな・・・:
Reaper Fruits have a face-like
pattern on them,
so don't get them mixed up...
entries.もう、あの森も安心だな・・・: I guess that forest is safe now...
entries.これもみんなお前さんのおかげだ・・・\nホラ、これはみんなからの礼がわりだ:
It's all thanks to you...
Here, this is our thanks from everyone
entries.これが死神の実を\nつぶしてくれた分:
This is for crushing
the Reaper Fruits
entries.そしてこれが森の怪物を\nやっつけてくれた分だ:
And this is for defeating
the forest monster
entries.これでまた、花も\nたねをつけることができるな・・・: Now the flowers can set seed again...
entries.よぉ!トンバじゃねーか・・・どうした、\nなにかききたいことでもあるのかい?\n:
Hey! It's Tomba... What's up? Is there something you want to ask?

...Ah, you mean the Great Bird that dropped you...
entries.あのトリは、そのむかし\n空の主ってよばれるほど りっぱで、\nりりしかったんだ:
That bird, long ago,
was so magnificent and dashing
that it was called the Lord of the Sky...
entries.今ははヨボヨボの\nおじいさんだけどな・・・:
Now it's just a feeble
old man, though...
entries.それに、あの山に嵐が吹くようになってから、\n山に近づけなくなったみたいなんだ・:
And ever since the storm started blowing on that mountain,
it seems it can't get near the mountain anymore...
entries.・・・そうだ!\n大トリのこうぶつを食べさせれば、\n少しは元気になるかもしれな:
...I know!
If we feed it the Great Bird's favorite food,
it might perk up a little...
entries.バンクの花だよ・・・\nマグマのどうくつにところどころ\nはえてるヤツ・・・\n:
It's the Bank Flower...
They grow here and there
in the Lava Cave...

If we get five of those,
it should be fine...
entries.でも、大トリの巣は\n炎の谷の先だからな・・・\n\nもし会いにいくんだったら、:
But the Great Bird's nest is beyond the Valley of Fire...

If you're going to meet it, be very careful...
entries.大トリのこうぶつは\nバンクの花だぞ・・・\nわすれんなよ!:
The Great Bird's favorite food
is the Bank Flower...
Don't forget!
entries.おっおっおっ・・・・・・おおっ!\nなおった!! いやぁ・・・たすかったよ\n\:
Oh oh oh... oh!
I'm healed!! Oh... I'm saved.

I ate some weird mushrooms in the forest...
I thought I was going to cry forever.
entries.・・・ああ、そうだ! あんた、\nコマブタのちっこいヤツ見たことないかい?\n\:
...Oh, right! Have you ever seen a little Koma Buta?

I hear it's called a Mago Buta,
but it's hard to find...

If you get one, let me have it,
I'll thank you properly
entries.おおっ!これこれ!!\n・・・よく見つけたなぁ よし!\n\nじゃあ、やくそくの:
Oh! That's it, that's it!!
...You found it, well done! All right!

Then, here's the good thing I promised...
...Ta-daaa!!

A Kokka Claw, rare in all the world!!
...Eh? What's rare about it?

W-well, well, don't be so stiff...
Anyway, I'll be going... thanks!
entries.私は人のけいけんの、レベルを\nつたえる占い師の一人です\n\nもともと私たちは:
I am one of the fortune tellers
who tell people their experience level

Originally, we can only speak
with those of high experience levels...

But I'm still in training,
so I'm making a special exception to tell your fortune.
entries.うーむ・・・\n\n・・・ピンクはあついところ・・\n\n・・・ミドリは 湖上の:
Hmm...

...Pink is a hot place...

...Green is the Mansion on the Lake

...Red awaits a miracle...
entries.かぁ〜・・・やっぱりここのサケが\nいちばんウマイな・・・:
Aaah... as always, the sake here
is the best...
entries.・・・となりのヤツ、さっきから\nミルクばっかりのんでるな・・・\n変わったヤツ:
...The guy next door has been drinking nothing but milk since earlier...
What a strange guy...
entries.ええっ! そんな所にいたんですか?\nわかりました・・・すぐに ほごします\n\:
What! He was in a place like that?
Understood... we'll take him into protection right away.

Oh... if you like,
please check the bulletin board again...
entries.おかげで助かりました: Thanks to you, I was saved.
entries.みぃ〜〜たぁ〜〜なぁ〜〜っ!!\n・・・・・・・・・・・\n\n・・・・・・・・:
You've seeeen meeee!!
...........

............
.........

What... you're not very startled.
...Oh, sorry about that...
I meant no harm.

As you can see, we look just like mice, don't we?
We're human, of course.

...This village has had the Evil Pigs' magic cast on it...
and all the villagers' forms
have been changed...
entries.まぁ、ふだんは おどろかさんように\nこうやってボウシをかぶっておるがな・・・\:
Well, normally I wear a hat like this
so as not to startle anyone...

...Oh, right!
You're a traveler, aren't you?
Would you do me a favor?
entries.わしはシュミでいろんな物を\n集めとるんじゃが・・・\n\nチーズの実がなかなか:
I collect all sorts of things as a hobby...

but I just can't seem to gather any Cheese Fruit...

If you find any Cheese Fruit on your travels,
would you collect them for me?...

Of course, I'll thank you
if you do.

Let me see — once you've gathered ten,
bring them to me...

I'll be waiting eagerly.
entries.どうじゃ、チーズの実は\n集まったかの・・・:
So, have you collected
the Cheese Fruit?...
entries.どうやら集まった様じゃのぉ・・・\nうむ・・・確かにチーズの実じゃ・・・\n\n:
It seems you've collected them...
Hm... yes, these are indeed Cheese Fruit...

That must have been hard...
Now, take this with you.
entries.おおっ!こんなに集めてくれたのか・・・\nこれは、とくべつなお礼をせんといかんな:
Oh! You gathered this many?...
I must give you a special reward for this...
The Golden Fruit...
entries.う〜ん・・・困った・・・\nこんな体じゃなければ・・・\nオレがポンプをなおすの:
Hmm... what a problem...
If I weren't in this body...
I'd fix the pump myself...
entries.おおっ! サケだ!\nまたサケが出るようになったぞ!\n\nずいぶんと助けてもら:
Oh! Sake!
The sake is flowing again!

You've really helped us a lot...
We don't have much here to thank you with,
...oh, I know!

The one thing we have plenty of is sake,
so just say so whenever you need some
...but kids shouldn't drink it.
entries.・・・え?カギを拾ったって?\n・・・ああ、それか・・・いいよ、\n\n持ってい:
...Huh? You picked up a key?
...Ah, that... sure,

take it. With it,
one of the doors in Thief Mansion
should open.
entries.よぉ!ずいぶん たすけてもらったな・・・\n・・・まぁ、オレたちもこんな体じゃな:
Hey! You've helped us a lot...
...If we weren't in these bodies,
we'd handle it ourselves...

...If only the Evil Pigs' magic were broken,
we'd go back to our old bodies...

...Oh, right, I left a treasure chest
in front of the Central Center, so
take it if you like...

...Though I don't know how to open it...
entries.森はきけんだから\n出ないほうがいいゼ: The forest is dangerous, so you shouldn't go out.
entries.キノコの森には\nボンスギーっていう怪物が出るんだ: There's a monster called Bonsugee in Mushroom Forest.
entries.・・・そんなにジロジロ見るなよ・・・\nオレたちは こう見えても\nふつうの人間:
...Don't stare at us like that...
We may look like this, but we're just ordinary humans...
entries.くそぉ・・・こんな体だと\n・・・よっぱらうのが早いや\n・・・ヒック!・・・:
Damn... in this body
...I get drunk fast
...Hic!...
entries.いやぁ〜びっくりした・・・\nあんた、きゅうに空から\n落ちてくるんだもん・・・:
Whoa, that startled me...
You suddenly dropped
out of the sky...
entries.大トリの山から来たの?\nあそこも魔ブタに魔法をかけられて、\nすっかり変わって:
Did you come from Great Bird Mountain?
That place was put under the Evil Pigs' magic too,
and changed completely...
entries.ここは 中央こうえん、\nあの たてものが中央センターだよ: This is Central Park, and that building over there is Central Center.
entries.この村の「お知らせ」かんけいは、\nこの「立て札」にはってあるから、\nたまには:
Village "notices"
are posted on this "signboard",
so take a look now and then
entries.・・・ん?\n見ないカオだね・・・\nここは、バッカスの村だよ・・・:
...Hm?
I don't recognize your face...
This is Bacchus Village...
entries.この村はバッカスの湖から\nポンプでサケを送ってたんだ・・・\nみんなの楽しみだ:
This village used to pump sake
from Lake Bacchus...
It was everyone's pleasure...
entries.近ごろサケが少なくって、\nめったに飲めないんだ・・・:
Lately there's not much sake,
and we hardly ever get to drink it...
entries.あんたを乗せてきた大トリは、\n頂上にある自分の巣の方向へ\nとんでいったよ: The Great Bird that carried you flew towards its nest at the top.
entries.いやぁ・・・この体って、\nけっこう ふべんなんだよね・・・:
Well... this body is
pretty inconvenient...
entries.そう言えば・・・\n中央センターのヤツが\n\nシーフマンションの小部屋のカギを:
Speaking of which...
The guy from the Central Center

had the key to the small room
in Thief Mansion...
entries.中央こうえんの「けいじばん」は、\nこまめにチェックしといたほうがいいゼ:
You'd better check
the bulletin board in Central Park
often
entries.ウワサじゃ、シーフマンションの\nどっかに「時の老人」のひとりが\n閉じ込められ:
Rumor has it that one of the "Old Men of Time"
is shut up somewhere
in Thief Mansion...
entries.湖のポンプをなおしてくれたんだって?\n中央センターには ほうこくしたかい?:
Did you fix the pump at the lake?
Did you report it to Central Center?
entries.ここはもう、通ってもいいからさぁ・・・\nボンスギーをやっつけてよ・・・:
You can come through here now, you know...
Just take care of Bonsugee...
entries.あんたのおかげで、\nまたサケが飲める・・・\nありがとうよ:
Thanks to you,
we can drink sake again...
Thank you
entries.このすがたも、なれれば\n楽しいんだけどね・・・: This form is also fun if you can get used to it...
entries.大トリの山の炎さえ消えれば、\n大トリの巣へいけるんだよ・・・:
If only the flames on Great Bird Mountain would go out,
you could get to the Great Bird's nest...
entries.シーフマンションには、\nへやがいっぱいあるからねぇ・・・\nいろいろ調べれば何:
Thief Mansion has so many rooms, you know...
If you investigate around, you might find something.
entries.そういえば・・・占い師のヤツ、\nかえってきたのかなぁ・・・: Speaking of which... I wonder if the fortune teller guy has come back...
entries.よぉ、トンバ!\nグルピンってしってるかい?\n・・・なんだ、しらないのか?\n:
Hey, Tomba!
Do you know about Grapple?
...Oh, you don't?

I've heard stories about it too, but apparently you can't proceed through Lava Cave without it...
entries.もう、あきらめてたんだけど\n・・・あんたなら、\n魔ブタを見つけ出せるかもね・: I had already given up, but… if it’s you, you might be able to find the Evil Pig…
entries.・・・ねぇ、あんたさぁ・・・\nこの村に魔法をかけた魔ブタも\nやっつけてくれな:
...Hey, you...
Could you take down the Evil Pig that cast magic on this village?
entries.オレたちも、もとのすがたに\nもどれるのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if we can return to our original form too...
entries.・・・よぉ!トンバ・・・\nいつも元気だな・・・\nあんまりムリするなよ:
...Hey! Tomba...
You're always so energetic...
Don't push yourself too hard.
entries.本当に、魔ブタを たおしちまったんだな\n・・・まったく たいしたヤツだよ:
You really did defeat the Evil Pig...
...What a remarkable guy
entries.おかげで もとの姿にもどれたよ!\nほんっとーに・・・ありがとうなっ!:
Thanks to you, I was able to return to my original form!
Really... thank you so much!
entries.わぁっ!ひさしぶり!?\nみんな すっごく げんきでしょ?\nこれも、トンバのお:
Wow! It's been so long!
Everyone's doing so well, aren't they?
This is all thanks to Tomba.
entries.占い師のなかまたちには\nもうあったかい?: Have you met the fortune tellers' friends yet?
entries.魔ブタってさぁ・・・\nどんなカオしてるんだい?\n\n・・・やっぱり、\nこわ:
The Evil Pig, huh...
What kind of face does it have?

...It must be a scary face,
after all...
entries.グルピンは、\nつかいこなせるようになったかい?: Have you become proficient at Grapple?
entries.どこかに 魔女がすんでるって\nはなしなんだけど・・・ほんとうなら、\n一度あっ:
I hear a witch lives somewhere...
If it's true,
I'd like to meet her once...
entries.この先バッカスの湖につながっているんだが\n・・・とてもあぶないんだ・・・\n特:
It leads to Lake Bacchus from here, but
...it's very dangerous...
If you've no particular business, give it up
entries.おまえさん・・・トンバとかいったっけ?\n湖のポンプをなおしてくれるんだったら、:
You... Tomba, was it?
If you're going to fix the lake's pump,
I'll show you the way.
entries.ごくろうさん・・・中央センターへ、\nほうこくするのもわすれずにな・・・: Thank you very much... Don't forget to report to Central Center...
entries.・・・おれ、思うんだけどさぁ・・・\nなきダケや わらいダケを食ったら\nげどく:
...I think, you know...
If you eat a Crying Mushroom or a Laughing Mushroom, you can cure it with an Antidote Mushroom, right?

...If it's some other mushroom...
For example, if you bite into a Mysterious Mushroom and go crazy, how do you cure that?

...Well, there are plenty of strange mushrooms over there...

Wouldn't it be okay if there was an Ordinary Mushroom like that...
entries.・・・えっ? 最後の魔ブタだって?\nよ〜しっ! わかった!\n・・・まかしとけ:
...Huh? The last Evil Pig?
Alright! Got it!
...Leave it to me!
entries.よぉ、トンバ! ひさしぶりだな\n・・・どうした??\n・・・アルコールがいるっ:
Hey, Tomba! Long time no see
...What's up??
...You need alcohol?

Sure, for Tomba, no problem
— take as much as you want
...But kids shouldn't drink it.
entries.集まったら持っといで…: Bring It When You've Collected Them...
entries.人魚の歌岩\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
Mermaid's Singing Rock
Save?
Yes → △  No → ×
entries.よぉ、レースに さんかするんだな?\n\n・・・まずは、きめられた せいげん時間:
Hey, so you're entering the race?

...First, what matters is finishing
within the set time limit...

And... the goal of this dirt motocross course
leads on to the Mermaid's Singing Rock...

Apparently, if you set a course record,
the mermaid will actually give you a medal!
entries.どうだ? もう、じゅんびは いいかい?\n・・・さぁ、時間がないぞ! 急げよっ!:
How's it going? Are you ready?
...Come on, we don't have much time! Hurry up!!
entries.はじめまして・・・キミ、なかなか速いわね・・・\nおめでとうっ! 銅メダルよ!!:
Hello... You're quite fast, aren't you...
Congratulations! Bronze medal!!
entries.・・・それと・・・はじめてキロクをだしたキミに、\nわたしからのプレゼントよ・・:
...And... for you, who set a record for the first time,
here's a present from me...
entries.さぁ、次は 銀メダルめざして\nがんばってね!: Alright, next up: aim for the silver medal and give it your all!
entries.かなり 速くなったわね・・・キミ!\nなかなか みどころが あるわよ・・・\n\:
You've gotten a lot faster... you!
You've got real promise...

Here! Congratulations!... A silver medal!!
entries.次は いよいよ 金メダルよ!: Next up: Finally, the gold medal!
entries.おめでとうっ!!・・・ついに やったわね!\n・・・キミ・・・そうとうハマッたで:
Congratulations!! ...Finally, you did it!
...You've really gotten hooked, haven't you?
I'm sure the development team will be amazed too!!

・・・・・・

Oh dear... I wonder what I'm saying...
Well, anyway... from today on, you're the champion!!
entries.これからも ベストタイムを出しつづけてね・・・: Please continue to achieve your best times from now on...
entries.お知らせ\nちかいうちに コースレコードを 発表しますので\nもう しばらくおま:
Notice
The course records will be announced soon,
so please wait a little longer
entries.コースレコード発表!\n1位・・・24秒96\n2位・・・26秒55\n3位・・:
Course Records Announced!
1st... 24.96 sec
2nd... 26.55 sec
3rd... 28.01 sec
entries.再チャレンジする?\nする→○ しない→×:
Would you like to try again?
Yes → ○ No → ×
entries.なにかを取り付ける穴があいている・・・: There's a hole for attaching something...
entries.・・・・・・かすかにポンプのおとがきこえる\n・・・どうやら なおったようだ・・:
......I can faintly hear the pump
...It seems to be fixed...
entries.ふぅ、なんとか たどりついたな\n・・・おれはここで待ってるから、\nよろしくな: Phew, I finally made it here... I'll be waiting here, so take care.
entries.死神の実をすべて つぶした: I crushed all the Reaper Fruit.
entries.このさき大トリの山・・・\n\nいつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・\nわ:
Beyond here is Great Bird Mountain...

A very dangerous mountain where a strong wind always blows...
The Elder told me to keep watch here...
...but it's awfully boring...

So I always practice here.
Eh? Practice for what?

......The truth is, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is really hard...
What kind of face should I make to move everyone...?
entries.ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!\nそ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・\n・・・:
Huh?... Whoooa!
T-that face full of sorrow!...
...I see...

If I master that laughing face from before and that crying face now...
Hm-hm...

...Mmmmmm...
I see it!!
Yes! Thank you!!

Thanks to you, I feel like I'm onto something!
Oops, no time to lose.
...Time to start training!!
entries.おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・\n花のナミダ、めぐみさまのふっかつにかかせない:
I came to get Flower Tears...
Flower Tears are essential to Lady Megumi's revival...

...If I can make this bud bloom,
it seems it will shed tears... but
...I don't know how to collect the tears...
entries.やっぱり、ウワサにきく\nナミダのびん ひつようかも\n・・・こまった・・・:
Maybe I need the Tear Bottle
everyone talks about...
...What a problem...
entries.はじまりの村に出かけますので、\nしばらく ふねは出せません:
I'm going out to the Village of Beginnings,
so I can't take the boat out for a while.
entries.やぁ、またあったね・・・\nふねに のりたいのかい?\n\nそれはかまわないけど:
Hey, we meet again...
Do you want a ride on my boat?

That's fine, but I'm busy too,
so it's one way only.
entries.ナミダのビンちょうだい: Please give me a tear bottle.
entries.老木の丘\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
Old Tree Hill

Save?
Yes → △ No → ×
entries.・・・いって〜〜〜\n\n・・・コラコラ、少年!\n・・・らんぼうなヤツだなぁ・:
