...Ouch~~~

...Hey, hey, kid!
...You're a rough one...

...Biting me out of the blue...
...Hm?... Wait a second...
entries.・・・うん、わかった・・・\n頼んでみるよ・・・:
...Okay, I understand...
I'll give it a try...
entries.・・じぃさんは、気にするなってさ・・・ちぇ\n・・・それと・・ひとつ頼みがあるん:
...The old man says not to worry about it... tsk
...And... I have one favor to ask...

As you can see, the old man is getting on in years...
He can't draw up nutrients by himself anymore,
and he's getting weaker and weaker...

There's apparently just one way
to restore this Old Tree... which is...
entries.この大陸のあちらこちらに\nポンプ岩ってのがあるんだけど・・・\n\n実は、その:
There are these things called Pump Rocks
all over this continent...

The thing is, they're full of
nutrient-rich water inside...

I think if you step on all the Pump Rocks
and return the nutrients to the ground,
the Old Tree should perk up...
entries.よぉ、少年!\n全てのポンプ岩をふんでくれたんだな\n・・・大変だったろ?\n\:
Hey, kid!
You stepped on all the Pump Rocks
...that must have been hard, right?

...Thanks to you, the old man of the Old Tree
is completely back in shape...
entries.じぃさんからの伝言だよ・・・\nこの老木は 百識の老木と言われるぐらい\nいろん:
A message from the old man...
This Old Tree knows so much
that it's called the Hundred-Knowledge Old Tree...

So he says that if you want to ask him anything
from here on, come back again...
entries.おおうっ!!・・・おまえっ!\nオレたちのなかまっ!\n・・・ひとりもキズつけな:
Whoa!!... You!
One of our friends!
...You didn't hurt a single one!
entries.おまえ えらいっ!\n・・・えらいなっ!\n・・・えらいぞっ!\n\nフンガのタ:
You're great!
...You're great!
...You're really great!

If we had a Funga Drum,
I'd feel like dancing!!
......Oh,

...This is a secret
...Forget it!!
entries.おまえっ!\n・・・??人の なかまっ!\n・・・キズつけたっ!!\n\nとても:
You!
...?? Our people's friends!
...You hurt them!!

I cannot forgive this!
...Bu~ut!
I'll give you a little chance!

From now!
Your!

past deeds!
I'll tell your fortune!

If you've done good things!
for that much!

hurting our friends!
I'll forgive specially!!

...Fungaaaaa!
...Hongaaaaa!
...Hai! Hai! Hai!!
entries.おおうっ!!\n・・・おまえっ!\n\n・・・けっこうイイヤツ!\nとくべつに:
Oooh!!
...You!

...You're quite a good one!
I'll forgive you, just this once!
entries.なんだ・・・おまえ、\nおよげないのか?\n困ったヤツだなぁ・・・:
What... can't you swim?
What a troublesome guy...
entries.まぁ・・・オイラが\n泳ぎをおしえてやってもいいんだけど・・・\n\nおっと、バ:
Well... I could teach you to swim, if you want...

Oh, no more bananas for me...
I love them, but
I'm a little tired of eating them...

More than that, I'm thirsty...
entries.あ、そうだ・・・オイラさぁ\n文明の国の入口ちかくで\nボウシをひろったんだ・・:
Oh, right... I
picked up a hat near the entrance
to the Land of Civilization...

If you're going there,
could you give it to its owner?

I bet they're in trouble...
entries.・・・いや、だから・・・バナナは\nもういいんだってば・・・おまえ、\n人のはな: ...No, that's why... I said I don't want any more bananas... You're not listening to what I'm saying...
entries.おおっ!\nそれはまさしく バナナジュース!!\n\nいつも わるいな・・・あと:
Oh!
That's definitely banana juice!!

Thanks, as always... I'll
drink it slowly later...
entries.それじゃ、やくそくどおり\nオイラが泳ぎをおしえてやるよ\n\nじゅんびは いい:
Alright, as promised, I'll teach you how to swim.

Are you ready?
If you want, you can jump into that river anytime.
entries.おぉ〜い! 聞こえるかぁ〜!\n・・・まずは おちつけ!\nあばれるから しずん:
Heeey! Can you hear me?!
...First, calm down!
If you thrash around, you'll sink!
entries.・・・そうそう・・・\nふつうにしてれば 水に浮くことができるんだ\n・・・でも:
...That's right...
If you do it normally, you can float on the water... but don't get too lazy!
entries.そして! あわてず さわがず\n進みたい方向に 方向キーをいれながら\n□ボタン:
And! Stay calm, don't panic.
Hold the direction key toward where you want to go
and press the □ button!

Every time you press the □ button,
you move forward!

The □ button, got it!

...
...Mmm
...Not bad at all, is it...

...By the way, the left side of this river
is a waterfall, so if you fall,
you're done for!
entries.そして! あわてず さわがず\n進みたい方向に 方向キーをいれながら\n×ボタン:
And! Stay calm, don't panic.
Hold the direction key toward where you want to go
and press the × button!

Every time you press the × button,
you move forward!

The × button, got it!

...
...Mmm
...Not bad at all, is it...

...By the way, the left side of this river
is a waterfall, so if you fall,
you're done for!
entries.そして! あわてず さわがず\n進みたい方向に 方向キーをいれながら\n○ボタン:
And! Stay calm, don't panic.
Hold the direction key toward where you want to go
and press the ○ button!

Every time you press the ○ button,
you move forward!

The ○ button, got it!

...
...Mmm
...Not bad at all, is it...

...By the way, the left side of this river
is a waterfall, so if you fall,
you're done for!
entries.そして! あわてず さわがず\n進みたい方向に 方向キーをいれながら\n△ボタン:
And! Stay calm, don't panic.
Hold the direction key toward where you want to go
and press the △ button!

Every time you press the △ button,
you move forward!

The △ button, got it!

...
...Mmm
...Not bad at all, is it...

...By the way, the left side of this river
is a waterfall, so if you fall,
you're done for!
entries.水の中でもジャンプできるから\nジャマなものがあれば\n飛びこせばいいゼ!:
You can jump in the water too,
so if something's in your way,
just jump over it!
entries.・・・もう、だいじょうぶみたいだな・・・\nじゃあ、こっちのハシゴに飛びつくんだ:
...Looks like you're fine now...
Then jump onto this ladder here!

To grab it, stand in front of the ladder,
hold up on the direction key, and jump!!
entries.・・・よ〜しっ!\n\n・・・いやぁ・・・こんなに早く\n泳ぎをマスターできるな:
...All right!

...Wow... mastering swimming this fast...
...even I'm amazed...
entries.やぁ!\nさっきは たいへんだったな・・・\nめげずに がんばるかい?\n\nヤ:
Hey!
That was tough earlier...
Are you going to keep trying without giving up?

If you're feeling motivated, jump into the river...
I'll keep playing with you as many times as you want!
entries.・・・ん? なんだい・・・\n聞きたいことがあるのかい?\n\n・・・ふむふむ・:
...Hm? What is it...
Is there something you want to ask?

...Hmm, hmm... the Five Great Golden Items?
...Got it. Wait here a bit
entries.・・・何か すごくムズカシイものを\n集めようとしてるなぁ・・・\n\nいいかい:
...You're trying to collect some really difficult things...

Listen...
According to the old man of the Old Tree...
entries.・・・金の花は、ドワーフの花だん・・・\n・・・黄金のフルーツは、バッカスの村・:
...The Golden Flower is in the Dwarves' flowerbed...
...The Golden Fruit is in Bacchus Village...
...The Gold Leaf Butterfly is in the Hidden Village...

...The Gold Candy is at the Witch's hut.....
...There's one more, but...
...he says he forgot...

But he says the motocross course area
looks suspicious.

Also... that goes for every item...
you have to do something at the spot
to get them...
entries.やぁ!元気かい?\n・・・なんか自信なくしちゃうなぁ:
Hey! How's it going?
...I feel like I'm losing my confidence somehow.
entries.ああ、とうさんのべんとう!\nとってもおいしいんだよ\n\n・・・わざわざ とど:
Oh, Dad's lunch box!
It's really delicious.

...You went out of your way to bring it.
But I'm full, so
you can have the lunch box.

...Try it, even if you think you're being fooled — it'll give you energy!
Even if you really are fooled, don't get mad...
You can have this too.

Well, I'm off!
entries.ああ、とうさんの 元気がでるべんとうを 食べたんだね\n気にすることはないさ・・:
Oh, you ate Dad's energizing lunch box?
Don't worry about it... So, how did it taste?

Oh, it was delicious!!
Hearing that perks me up too.

...Well, I'm off now
...See you.
entries.うわあぁぁぁーーーっ!\nこっ こないでっ! おねがいっ!\n・・・・・・・・・:
Waaaah!
D-don't come near me! Please!
.........Huh?...

Wh-what... you're not Masakari...
Whew, you scared me...
Sorry for startling you...

I'm from the Clock Tower
in the land of civilization ahead...
entries.この辺でボウシを\n風に飛ばされちゃってさぁ・・・\n\nさっき ヘンテコリンな:
My hat got blown away by the wind around here...

I saw a weird monkey with it a moment ago,

and I'd like to chase it myself, but...
I'm too scared of the Masakari tribe
to go... so, you...

If you see a strange monkey
in striped pants,
could you somehow get it back for me?
entries.うおぉぉぉーーーっ!!・・・・・・\nだから、急に声をかけるなって・・・\n\n:
Whoaaaa!!......
I told you not to call out so suddenly...

I'm a timid guy...

So, did you find my hat?
entries.これだよ、これっ!\n・・・ありがとう おかげで助かったよ・・・\n\nもし、よ:
This is it, this is it!
...Thank you, you saved me...

If you like,
would you stop by our Clock Tower?

...You probably can't get into the workshop or the Iron Castle,
but the Clock Tower you're welcome to enter any time...
entries.なんじゃ!\n・・・かってに 人の家にあがりこんでくるとは\n失礼なヤツじゃな・:
What!
...Barging into someone's house uninvited,
what a rude fellow...

Hm?... The 10,000-Year-Old Man?
...Now, now!!
How dare you call people by name without respect!!
entries.・・・・・・・・・何じゃ?\n魔ブタの話が聞きたいじゃと?\n\n・・・・・・そ:
......What is it?
You want to hear about the Evil Pigs?

......I see...
So the 100-Year-Old and the 1,000-Year-Old
were talking about you...

Hm......
Then let's do this...

As you can see, this Karakuri Village
is sunk under water...

In that water, I've hidden
ten beads with numbers written on them...

If you can collect them all...
I'll tell you what you want to know...
entries.・・・ただし!\n・・・泳げるだけでは 数字玉は集められんぞ・・・\n潜ることが:
...However!
...Just swimming won't let you collect the Number Balls...
Not unless you can dive...

Hyah, hyah, hyah....

Oops... don't glare at me with such a scary face...
All right, let me tell you something good
entries.・・・少し前に\nわしのところに人魚がたずねてきてな・・・\n\n何でも 探して:
...A little while ago
a mermaid came to see me...

Apparently she found something precious she'd been looking for
partway up the waterfall ahead,

but she says she can't get it herself...
She looked so sad...

So if you...
were to fetch that precious thing for her...

she might teach you how to dive...

...By the way, that mermaid
should be resting at Thief Mansion now...
entries.ほぉ・・・なんとか\n潜れるように なったみたいじゃな・・・\nしかし、これから:
Hoh... you seem to have managed to dive...
But the real thing starts now...

Ah... by the way...
have you ever met the Witch
who lives in the Village of Beginnings?

...They say she can do all sorts of wondrous things...
Let me see... what was it now...

I hear there's even magic
that makes what you hold stronger...

Oops... no, no...
Lately my mouth has been running loose,
and that won't do...

Hya-ha-ha...
entries.まぁ、せっかく潜れるようになったんじゃ・・・\nしっかり10個の数字玉を探すんじ:
Well, now that you can finally dive...
be sure to find all ten Number Balls...
entries.・・・うむっ!\nまちがいなく わしがかくした数字玉じゃ・・・\n\nごくろうじ:
...Hm!
These are indeed the Number Beads I hid...

Thank you for your trouble...
I wasn't being spiteful, you know...

After all, our opponent
is those Evil Pigs...

I just had to see
how hard you would try...

But... thanks to your efforts,
I've been able to fulfill my duty...

...Hm?
My duty?.........

To get you able to dive underwater,

and to have you get
this Karakuri Village's Seal Bag...

Hya-ha-ha......
Oh, that's right...

Without handing you this,
you couldn't get the Seal Bag...
Here, the 10,000-Year Key...
entries.あとは、魔ブタの話じゃが・・・\n\nこれは、億年老人に\n聞いたほうが早いじゃ:
As for the Evil Pigs...

It'll be quicker to ask the 100-Million-Year-Old Man...

After all, the 100-Million-Year-Old is the eldest
of us Old Men of Time...

He should be able to tell you
where those Evil Pigs get that power...
entries.・・・地下迷宮のカギはと・・・\nおお、あったあった・・・これじゃ・・・:
...The key to the Underground Maze is...
Oh, here it is, here it is... this is it...
entries.億年老人は高見ヤグラの下・・・\n森の地下迷宮に住んでおる・・・\n\nきをつけ:
The 100-Million-Year-Old Man lives
beneath the Watch Tower...
in the Underground Maze of the forest...

Be careful on your way...
entries.・・・ん、何を見ておるんじゃ?\n\nおお、ワシの見事なコレクションに目を\nう:
...Hm, what are you looking at?

Oh, are you entranced by my splendid collection?

Rare, aren't they!
But the prize fish
is the one on that table.

This is called the Psychic Fish.
They say that if you use it,
it lends its holder a mysterious power.

...Don't give me such covetous looks...

Hmm, well, if you traded me
all of the things called the Five Great Golden Items,
I might consider it...

But there's no way — you have no idea
where they are, do you...

I'll tell you at least their names...

First the golden flower and the golden fruit,
the gold Leaf Butterfly and the gold candy.

Huh? What was the one more...?

Well, never mind.
I won't give it up unless you bring all five!
entries.何回見ても、\n見事な魚じゃのう・・・: No matter how many times I look at it, it's a magnificent fish...
entries.うぉぉ!!\n\nこのかがやき・・・\nまちがいなく 黄金アイテムじゃ!\n\n:
Whoa!!

This shine...
Without a doubt, it's a golden item!

I never imagined you'd actually collect them...
What a truly remarkable person you are...

Very well, in exchange for the Psychic Fish...
entries.超能魚は すばらしい力を与えてくれるが、\n使い方をまちがえると\n命にかかわる:
The Psychic Fish grants amazing powers, but if you use it incorrectly, it can be life-threatening, so listen carefully.

Using this fish allows you to run faster like a superhuman and increase your jumping ability, but

if you get carried away and run too fast or jump too high, you'll end up diving into a valley...

If you no longer need it, use the Psychic Fish again to return to normal...

In short, knowing when to use it is important; be careful not to waste your power...

Is that clear?
entries.かわった 魚はおらんかのう・・・: I wonder if there isn't an unusual fish about...
entries.コトバを吸いとろう!工: Let's Soak Up the Language! I
entries.よぉ、ビックリしたかい?\nこのボンスギーは、おれが苦労して\nやっとつかまえた:
Hey, did I startle you?
I went through a lot of trouble
to finally catch this Bonsugee...

I've been researching the Mushroom Forest,
and I've found out something interesting...

Well? Want to hear it?
You do, don't you?... Come on,
don't say no, just listen...
entries.・・・花のナミダって知ってるかい?\nキノコの森にいるフラワーから\n手に入るん:
...Do you know about Flower Tears?
You can get them from the Flowers
in the Mushroom Forest...

To catch the tears
you need a special container...

My research tells me that a yellow Bonsugee
that used to be in the Mushroom Forest
has one, but

...maybe if the Evil Pigs' magic over the whole forest
is broken, you might be able to get it...
entries.・・・あぁ、そうだ・・・\nナミダをながす花は\nキノコの森でも 一つしかないん:
...Oh, right...
There's only one flower in the Mushroom Forest
that sheds tears...

It's the one still in bud...
You should be able to wake it up
with the Awakening Powder that ordinary Bonsugee carry
entries.たくさんの 石炭が入っている\n・・・何に使うんだろう・・・: There's a lot of coal inside... I wonder what it's used for...
entries.よぉ!\n・・・バクダンは うまく使えたみたいだな?\n\n・・・おまけにあんた:
Hey!
...It seems like you were able to use the bomb skillfully, huh?

...And on top of that, thanks to you, the generator seems to have been fixed...

What a truly remarkable person you are.
entries.・・・ああ、そうそう・・・むかし、\nおれのジィさんから 聞いたんだけど\n\n:
...Oh, right, right...
I heard from my grandfather long ago

...that the Whatsit Tower in the Dwarf Forest
has an elevator
leading underground...
entries.おおおぉぉぉ・・・・・・\nダメかぁ・・・ただの水だもんなぁ・・・\n\nエサね:
Ohhhh...
No good... it's just water...

For bait fuel,
I'll need to use that stuff after all......
entries.コイツは ボフットカーっていうんだけど\n・・・コイツを動かすには\nエサねんり:
This thing is called a Bofutokar,
...and to make it run
it needs bait fuel.

But... the one thing you can't do without
for making that bait fuel
is hard to come by...

Well, it's nothing special,
...just a tiny bit of alcohol
...let me see.

When you say alcohol, you think
of Bacchus Village, right?

If you go to the pump in the central park there,
you should be able to get some.
entries.・・・なぁ、そこに ぶっこわれた\n大きなトビラが見えるだろ?\n\nおれさぁ、:
...Hey, you see that big broken-down
door over there?

I was curious,
so I went inside just once
...guess what was there?

Water, water... and it was black...
That was creepy......
entries.・・・おれか? おれは\nこの加工場をあずかる しょくにんさ\n\n・・・まぁ、:
...Me? I'm the craftsman
who looks after this workshop.

...Well, not to brag...
but there's nothing I can't make... probably.
entries.ん? あぁ・・・鉄の城のトビラかぁ\n・・・あれは 古いトビラでな・・・\n\n:
Hm? Oh... the door to the Iron Castle?
...That's an old door...

Unless you blow it away with a bomb or something,
you probably can't get in at all...
entries.バクダンの作り方?・・・\nはあっ!はあっ!はっ!・・・\nおいおい、本気にした:
How to make a bomb?...
Ha! Ha! Ha!...
Hey, did you take that seriously?

What an honest kid... well, true,
nobody has gone that far before.

.........the truth is... I have one
......that bomb...
entries.おれが昔 作ったやつなんだけどな・・・\n\nあぶないし、使いみちも思いつかなか:
I made it a long time ago...

It's dangerous and I couldn't think of a use for it,
so I hid it at the top of the tallest tree
in the jungle...

It might be a little hard to find...
Search carefully among the leaves at the very top...

It's a pretty powerful one, so it'll probably blast the iron door too...
But do be careful...
entries.おいおい・・・そのバクダン\n強力だから 気をつけろよ・・・: Hey hey... that bomb is powerful, so be careful...
entries.だあぁぁぁっ!!!\n・・・こ、こんなところで使うなよっ!\n\n・・・あんたが:
Waaaah!!!
...D-don't use that in a place like this!

...What you want to break
is the rusty door, isn't it?
entries.どうだい?\nトビラは上手く こわせたかい?:
Well?
Did you manage to break the door?
entries.・・・ん〜っ・・・\nなにか つくりたいなぁ・・・\n\nおれの ウデをふるえる:
...Mmm...
I want to make something...

Isn't there something
worth making,
that would let me show off my skill...
entries.・・・えぇっ! あんた\nマサカリ族につかまったのか?・・・\nよく、無事だった:
...What! You got captured
by the Masakari tribe?...
It's lucky you got out safe...
entries.そういえば・・・\nウワサに聞いたんだけど\n\nマサカリ族は むかしから\nフ:
Come to think of it...
I heard a rumor

that the Masakari tribe has held festivals
with Funga's Great Drum
since long ago...

It's supposed to be a drum with a wonderful sound,
but the materials are hard to get...

If I had the materials...
I'd love to try making it...

I know!...
The all-knowing tree
might know something...
entries.あ!・・・\nあんたの持っている それはっ!・・・\n\nフンガの大タイコをつく:
Ah!...
What you're carrying there!...

Isn't that the material
for making Funga's Great Drum?

...I don't know how you got it,
but...
will you let me make the Great Drum?

...All right! Leave it to me!
I'll make one so great
even the Masakari tribe will be knocked off their feet!
entries.まぁ、つくるのに\nちょっと時間がかかるからさ・・・\n町の外でも さんぽ して:
Well, it'll take a little while
to make...
so go take a walk outside town
entries.・・・できたぜ!\nわれながら ホレボレするデキだ・・・\nほら、見てやってくれ:
...It's done!
Even I'm in love with how it turned out...
Here, take a look
entries.いやぁ〜 \nひさしぶりに たのしかったぜ・・・\nありがとよ:
Man,
that was fun for the first time in ages...
Thanks
entries.おおっ!\nこっ、これは!?\n\n・・・バッカスの村名産!\nバッカス十四代:
Whoa!
Th-this is...!?

...Bacchus Village's famous product!
Bacchus Fourteenth Generation Daiginjo!!
The legendary sake is right here!!...

Huh?... Just lake water?...
Wh-what a stupid thing to say!

This is a premium...
What am I getting so excited about?...
Oh, never mind...

Don't worry, I won't drink it or anything...
All right!
entries.あれを こーして・・・\nこれが あーなって・・・・・・・・・\n\nよし! で:
This goes like this...
and that becomes this.........

All right! Done!!
entries.・・・なんだい ボクに何か ようかい?\n\n・・・ボクは イカダを せんもんに:
...What is it? Do you need something from me?

...I'm a raft craftsman,
I make nothing but rafts, but...

lately nobody has any use for them...
entries.・・・何だって?・・・\nイ、イカダがほしいって?・・・・・・\n\nくぅ〜〜〜:
...What?...
Y-you want a raft?......

Ooooh...
That's a nice thing to say...
All right, got it!

I'll get things ready
at the workshop,
so you go pick up some lumber
entries.・・・ボクがよく使うのは\n百識の老木の下に\nときどき落ちてやつなんだ\n\n:
...The kind I usually use
is what sometimes falls
under the Hundred-Knowledge Old Tree

Well, I'm counting on you
entries.よ〜〜しっ! まってな・・・\nすぐできるからなっ!:
Alright! Wait for me...
I'll be ready soon!
entries.トンテンカン・・・ギ〜コギ〜コ・・・\nバキッ メリッ・・・いてっ!・・・\nト:
Clang clang... Zzzik zzzik...
Crack! Splinter... Ow!...
Clang clang...

All right! Done!...
If you use this by the river on Old Tree Hill,
you can ride the raft
entries.万年老人に会うんだったら\n気をつけなよ・・・\nけっこう 変わり者らしいから・:
If you're going to meet the 10,000-Year-Old Man,
be careful...
I hear he's quite an oddball...
entries.私は 300000APの\nけいけんを持っている方にしか\nお話しできません・・:
I can only speak with someone
who has 300000 AP of experience...
entries.・・・あなたの けいけんは\n十分なようですね・・・\nそれでは 見てみましょう:
...It seems your experience is sufficient...
Let's take a look...
entries.う〜む・・・紺は 浜辺のトビラ・・・\nオレンジは 湖上のやかた・・・\n黄は:
Hmm... Navy is the Door on the Beach...
Orange is the Mansion on the Lake...
Yellow is the Keeper of Time...

...Do you know what that means?
entries.じゃっ! おれはコイツの\nしうんてんでも してくるぜ\n・・・アディオス アミ:
Well! I'm off
for a test drive of this baby
...Adiós, amigo!
entries.いやぁ・・・\nキミには せわになったからなぁ・・・\nおれでよかったら きょう:
Well...
I'm in your debt...
If I'll do, I'll help you out!
entries.この小屋に 占い師がいるんだけど・・・\nじょうけんがあるらしくて\n何も 占っ:
There's a fortune teller in this hut...
but there seem to be conditions,
and they won't tell me a thing...
entries.・・・やっぱり 木がいちばんだよなぁ・・・\n石とか鉄なんて つめたくってダメさ:
...Still, wood is the best, isn't it...
Stones and iron are too cold and no good...
entries.動かないけど・・・このキカイ 鉄だよな・・・\nべんりなら 使いたいんだけど・・:
It doesn't run... but this machine is iron, isn't it...
I'd like to use it if it's useful... but I guess not...
entries.ここの床下は めいろになっとるんじゃ・・・\nうかつに入ってはいかんぞ・・・:
The space under the floor here is a maze...
Don't go in carelessly...
entries.そこの小屋は 床下をとおらないと行けないんだ・・・\nおれは フベンだとおもうん:
You can't get to that hut
without going under the floor...
I think it's inconvenient, myself
entries.・・・ハグルマ?・・・\nそんなもん、木でつくったら スグにこわれちまうぞ:
...Gears?...
If you made those out of wood, they'd break right away
entries.上に見える入口から 加工場に行けるんだ・・・\nヒマなら一度 行ってみろよ・・・:
You can go to the workshop from the entrance you see above...
If you're free, you should go check it out...
entries.・・・このカンバン・・・だいぶ古いからねぇ・・・\nけっこうあぶないよ・・・いや:
...This sign... it's quite old, you know...
It's pretty dangerous... no, seriously...
entries.そこに 大きな岩があるだろ?・・・・・・\nジャマなんだよなぁ・・・:
There's a big rock there, right?...
It's such a nuisance...
entries.あ〜ぁ・・・ノドが かわいたなぁ・・・\nジャングルのヤシの実でも とりに行こう:
Ahh... my throat feels so dry...
Maybe I should go get some coconuts from the jungle...
entries.あんた・・・いつも元気だねぇ\nあんたを見てると なんだかウキウキしてしまうよ・: You... you're always so energetic. Watching you makes me feel all excited...
entries.そういえば・・・\nこのヘンテコな乗り物の 持ち主・・・\nどこに行ったんだろ?:
Speaking of which...
The owner of this strange vehicle...
Where did he go?
entries.・・・この国も・・・魔ブタの魔法がとけたら\n生まれ変わらなくっちゃな・・・:
...This country too... if the Evil Pigs' magic is broken
it'll have to be reborn...
entries.時計台は動いたのに・・・\nやっぱり町の中はダメか・・・:
The Clock Tower moved, but...
Is the town still no good...?
entries.そこの小屋のイカダしょくにん・・・\n元気に してるかねぇ:
The raft craftsman in that hut...
I wonder if he's doing well
entries.からくり村は 水にしずんだ村さ・・・\n万年老人とか言うじぃさんが いるらしいけ:
Karakuri Village is a village submerged in water...
Apparently there's an old man called the 10,000-Year-Old Man.
entries.おれも 勇気を出して・・・\n石人のヨメさんでも もらおうかな・・・\nだって:
I'll muster my courage too...
and maybe take a Stone People wife...
Cute, aren't they?
entries.木人の村の大岩: The Great Rock of the Wood People's Village
entries.見えないカガミ?: The Mirror You Can't See In?
entries.黒い水の不思議: The Mystery of the Black Water
entries.・・・うわっ おおおおまえ、\nどこからきたんだ?\n\nここは、嵐をよぶ オレ:
...Whoa! Y-y-you,
where did you come from?

This is the home of me, the storm-caller,
the Storm Evil Pig!

Good kids should go home and go to bed
.....
...Whaaat~~

Everybody's troubled by the storm??
...Pfft!
Not my problem!

I do what I want, see!
How about this wind?
That's me for you!

Whaaat~~ A golden bracelet???
...Hmph! Isn't gold pretty!
What's wrong with collecting it?

Look, this storm!
That's me all right! This is my era!

...
Looks like you don't get it
Well, here I come
entries.・・・はて\nおかしなガキが おるわい・・・\nなまいきな かおをしておるの\n:
...Well, well
what a strange brat we have here...
with a cheeky face on him

What an odd little brat, really
....A thieves' hideout, you say?
....Don't know, don't know!

What came before we Evil Pigs showed up
is none of my business

Hm? What's that... I see, I see
You want a good zapping?
Alriiiight, here I come!!!!
entries.・・・う〜わ!!\nまた服が破けたじゃねえか・・・\n\nちょっと 力をこめりゃ:
...Wah!!
My clothes are torn again...

I flex a little,
and this is what happens

Huh? Who are you?
...What!
You're going to take me down?

Hahaha... take a look at my muscles
and my torn clothes before you say that...
What can a skinny body like yours do?

Go home, go home! I have to change
into new clothes...

...What, you're still here?
......
Pushy guys aren't liked, you know

Oh well!
Don't come complaining to me
even if those pants get shredded!!
entries.チョット!\n気持ちよく ネてたのに\n何なのよアンタ\n\n・・・あ!! レデ:
Hey!
I was sleeping so nicely,
and who are you?!

...Ah!! In front of a lady,
put on some proper clothes...
Honestly, really...

...Gah!!
My nose is turned up again!!

It used to turn up when I slept face down...
so why... today I wasn't even
sleeping face down!!

Well then, I'll take it out
on you, who saw my bare face
Prepare yourself!!!
entries.ルルル〜〜なぜ空は青いのか〜〜それは\nカンタンな事〜〜〜ラララ〜〜\n青いとい:
Lu-lu-lu~~ Why is the sky blue~~ It's
a simple matter~~~ La-la-la~~
Because there's a word called "blue"~~~

Thank you! Thank you!!
In answer to everyone's encore,
today's special service: I'll sing the second verse too!!

One, two, three, four, wah!!
You scared me... You there,
how long have you been here?

...Quite a while? Eek, how embarrassing!!
It seems my angel voice
has been overheard...

Can't be helped, I'll read
you a book...
Eh... that's not it?

Heh, I was just clowning around a bit...
From here on I'm serious
— brace yourself!
entries.ブクブク・・・誰?\nうぉーーーーーーーあれに 見えるは!\n黄色の封印ぶくろ!:
Glub glub... who's there?
Whoaaaaa, what I see there!
A Yellow Seal Bag!

Um, I haven't done anything wrong
......really, I mean it
...uh-huh

Oh, right... you're a good swimmer
but if you stay in the water too long, look!
Your complexion goes bad, like mine

Hmm, I guess there's nothing for it but to fight
...but I've got my pride as an Evil Pig, too

In the water I wouldn't lose even to a fish...
I can do it... here I come!
entries.・・・・・ふーん、\nどんな相手が来たかと思ぅとったが\n・・・うぅぅん・・・何:
......Hmm, I wondered what kind of opponent
would show up
...Hmmm... what's this...

And now... a boy?
What... hmmm... what kind of joke is this?

I thought a lot more
lively grown-ups...
would be coming

But no matter how many come
...hmm, I won't lose...
...Why?

Hmmm... let me see...
This place is... hmmm, I won't tell you!

If you fight, you'll find out whether you like it or not...
Hmmm... you're putting on airs, aren't you~
entries.やっと来たね、トンバ!!\nまちくたびれたよ まったく・・・\nボク、7匹の魔ブ:
You finally came, Tomba!!
I've been waiting so long, really...
I'm the real Evil Pig, the one who made the seven Evil Pigs

Weren't they fun, those Evil Pigs?...
I made them so that someday people
like Tomba, who come at me, could enjoy themselves

Yeah, that's right, to me
it's the same as a game...

For example, Tomba!
If you make Tomba the hero, this world too
is, to me...

just one of the many games
that spilled out of the toy box...
...........Is that hard to follow?

So let's enjoy the climax to the fullest!
Even if Tomba is the hero, I'm the one who wins in the end!

Hehehe... Hahaha...
Come at me any time!
entries.こっ!・・・これは!?・・・・・・\nなぜじゃっ!・・・魔ブタは たしかに\n7:
Th-this is...!?......
Why!... I was sure
all seven Evil Pigs were sealed......

......A new Seal Bag and
Evil Pig Gate............
Surely not!
entries.・・・おちついて 聞いて下され・・・・・・\nわたしも ただのウワサだと\n思っ:
...Stay calm and listen......
I thought it was only a rumor myself, but...

......It seems one more new Evil Pig
is in hiding... Most likely,

the one who has been pulling the strings
of the seven Evil Pigs from the shadows......
the true Evil Pig......

But we have the Seal Bag, and the door is right before us
......Let's go straight through now......
entries.フフフ・・・フハハハハハ・・・・・・\nこの、トビラの中に入れるわけには いかな:
Heh heh heh... Hwa-ha-ha-ha-ha......
I can't let you in through this door...

Go ahead and fume out there as much as you like... Ha ha ha
...Haaa-ha-ha-ha......
entries.おおっ・・・・・・なんということだ\n・・・・・・やはり 力無きものは・・・\n:
Ohh......What a thing
......As expected, those without strength
must follow the strong...

......Hm?... What is this...?
entries.そうか! 友達か!・・・・・・\n友達を7人 つれてくるんじゃな・・・:
I see! Friends, then!......
So you'll bring seven friends with you...
entries.・・・・・・フムフム・・・・・・これは、\nいっしゅのカラクリのようじゃな・・・:
......Hm-hm...... This seems to be
some kind of mechanism...

Now that the Evil Pig that stood on this pedestal
is gone, the door has closed...

If so... someone just has to stand
on these seven pedestals again......

Then the door should open again...
entries.よしっ!・・・わしは あなたが\nもどってくるまで ここで待っているから\n\n:
All right!... I'll wait here
until you come back

...Tell your friends to come straight here.
I'll explain the rest...

......I'm counting on you......
entries.おおっ! そうじゃ・・・思い出したっ!\n・・・あなたに こいつを\nあずけてお:
Oh! That's right... I remember now!
...I'll leave this one with you...
entries.どうですかな?\n・・・・・・おぼえておりますかな\n\n・・・こいつは あなた:
Well?
......Do you remember?

...This is the puppy you saved
in the Dwarf Forest

......Since it finally got better,
I've been looking after it

...Baron has a mysterious power
...If you use Baron on the item screen,
he has the same effect as the Megumi Wings

......Now, Baron... off you go...
entries.おおっ!\nそうじゃ・・・思い出したっ!\n\n・・・あなたに こいつを\nあず:
Oh!
That's right... I remember now!

...I'll leave this one with you...
entries.こいつは バロンと言いましてな\n\n・・・・・・ドワーフの森で\nケガをしてい:
This one is called Baron

......He was hurt in the Dwarf Forest,
so I've been raising him...

He's sure to be a help to you...
Think of him as a friend and treasure him
...Baron has a mysterious power

...If you use Baron on the item screen,
he has the same effect as the Megumi Wings
......Now, Baron... off you go...
entries.石人の町\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
Town of Stone People

Save?
Yes → △ No → ×
entries.・・・ん〜っ・・・\nなにか つくりたいなぁ・・・\n\nおれの ウデをふるえる:
...Mmm...
I want to make something...

Isn't there something
worth making,
that would let me show off my skill...
entries.・・・えぇっ!\nあんた マサカリ族につかまったのか?\n・・・よく、無事だった:
...What!
You got captured by the Masakari tribe?
...It's lucky you got out safe...
entries.そういえば・・・\n\nウワサに聞いたんだけど マサカリ族は\nむかしから フン:
Come to think of it...

I heard a rumor that the Masakari tribe
has held festivals with Funga's Great Drum
since long ago...

It's supposed to be a drum with a wonderful sound,
but the materials are hard to get...
If I had the materials... I'd love to try making it

...I know!
...The all-knowing tree
might know something...
entries.キミ、いろんなところを旅してるんだって?\nだったら、へんな点とか線がきざんであ:
I hear you've been traveling all over?
Then, have you ever seen a Scribble Rock
with strange dots and lines carved on it?...

I saw one a long time ago
at the Wood People's workshop,
and I've been curious about it ever since...
entries.ウワサじゃ\n全部で6つのらくがき岩があって、\n\nそこに書かれてあるナゾをと:
Rumor has it
that there are six Scribble Rocks in all,

and if you solve the mystery written on them
you can get lots of treasure
...or so they say

...It sounds hard
...a 1 for ー and a 5 for...

Something about base 20...
I can't make heads or tails of it...
entries.キミ、この先の時計台に 何か用かい?: You, do you have business at the Clock Tower up ahead?
entries.ざんねんだけど・・・\n今、時計台はこわれてて\n動かないんだ・・・:
Too bad...
the Clock Tower is broken right now
and doesn't run...
entries.・・・そうだ!\nこの少年におねがいして、\n鉄人にたのんでもらおうか?:
...I know!
Let's ask this boy
to ask the Iron People for us?
entries.でも・・・鉄人にたのむのは\nシャクだしなぁ・・・:
But... asking the Iron People
would stick in my craw...
entries.どうだった?\nおれの作ったジュースはウマかっただろ?\n・・・・・・何だって!:
How was it?
The juice I made was good, wasn't it?
......What!?

...You swam that river?......
Amazing...

That river is famous for its fast current
............I know!...

Given your courage,
there's something I'd like to ask of you...
The truth is... as you can see...
entries.・・・この時計台はずっと\n止まったままなんだ・・・\n\nここのハグルマを動か:
...This Clock Tower has been stopped
for ages...

To get the gears here moving,
the machine has to be started...
but there are all sorts of problems...

Well, why don't you go take a look
at the machine room in the Iron Castle...

I'll make sure you can go freely
through the workshop and the Iron Castle...
entries.ほんとうに キカイを動かしちまうなんてな\n・・・おかげで、時計台が生き返ったよ:
To think you actually got the machine running
...Thanks to you, the Clock Tower is alive again...

Hm? Oh, don't go to the gear room anymore...
Big gears are moving
all over the place

It's very dangerous...
entries.よぉ! あの時のボウズじゃないか・・・\n\nどうだい? この時計台・・・\nな:
Hey! Aren't you the kid from that time...

Well? This Clock Tower...
pretty fine thing, isn't it?

This Clock Tower, the Iron Castle and the workshop,
all three together,
are called the Land of Civilization

...Well, civilization or not,
all the machines have stopped...

...Oh, by the way...
Thanks to you I didn't lose my precious hat

...Really, thank you...

...I'd like to thank you somehow...
...I know!

Have some of my proud juice
...It's tasty, you know
entries.・・・とっとっと・・・ しまった!\nかんじんのバナナがねーや・・・\n\nなに:
...Whoa, whoa, whoa... Oops!
The bananas, the whole point, are missing...

You see, my specialty is banana juice

...But, well... bananas are in the jungle...
and the jungle is Masakari territory...
entries.おお ボウズっ!\n時計台の歯車・・・\nおまえが直してくれたんだってな・・・\:
Hey, kid!
The Clock Tower's gears...
I heard you fixed them...

Still, iron gears, of all things...
Feels like we're in the Iron People's debt,
which is a bit galling...

Well, those won't
break, I bet... yeah

...Oh, right!
I promised to treat you to some juice...

...Oops, damn...
the bananas, the whole point, are missing

...You see, my specialty is
banana juice...
But, well...

bananas are in the jungle...
and the jungle is Masakari territory...
entries.おおっ!?・・・\nなんだ、わざわざ取ってきてくれたのか?\n・・・よ〜し・・・:
Oh!?...
What, you went out of your way to fetch them?
...All right... wait a moment
entries.・・・はあっ!!・・・\nフン! フン! フン!\n\n・・・ぎゅ〜っ とな・・:
...Hah!!...
Hup! Hup! Hup!

...Squeeeze...
Squeeze squeeze squeeeze...
entries.おれの作るジュースは人気あるんだぜ\n味わって のんでくれよ\n・・・ああ、それ:
The juice I make is popular, you know
Drink it and taste it
...Oh, and...

You'd better stay away from the river...
Well... nobody would swim
in a current that fast......

But if someone had enough courage
to swim there...

they might solve
our troubles...
entries.なぁなぁ、聞いてくれよ・・・\nおれさぁ 始まりの村から\n 帰ってきたんだけど:
Hey, hey, listen...
I just came back from the Village of Beginnings...

And there, for the first time...
I saw the Witch!

Her name is Mizuno, they say...
And she's really cute...

Ah...
I'd like to meet her again...
entries.この、カベにくっついてる\nエレベーターらしいんだけど・・・\n動かないんだよね:
This seems to be an elevator
stuck to the wall...
but it won't move...
entries.何だって・・・ほかの町に入れない?\n・・・知らねぇーな・・・\nあんなヤツラと:
What... can't I enter another town?
...I don't know...
I don't want to get involved with those guys...
entries.ほかの町のヤツラ・・・\n\nどうも わたしたちのこと\nバカにしてるみたい・・:
The guys from other towns...

It seems like they're making fun of us...
I'm going to lose my temper!
entries.この町は はじめてかい?\n\nそうだなぁ\nじまんできるのは時計台ぐらいなんだ:
Is this town your first time?

Well, the only thing I can boast about is the Clock Tower, but it's a bit…
entries.はいろぉーかなぁ・・・\n\nでも井戸には入るなって\nいわれてるしなぁ・・・\:
I wonder if I should go...

But I've been told not to enter the well...
What should I do...?
entries.なんだ・・・\nハグルマ 見てきたのか?\n\n・・・う〜ん・・・\nどうしたも:
What...
Did you see the gear?

...Hmm...
What should I do...?
entries.こわれないハグルマ?\nそりゃあ、鉄で作れば・・・\n\nでも、あたしは\n木と:
A gear that won't break?
Well, if you make it out of iron...

But I don't like wood or iron...
entries.へへ・・・こっそり、\n鉄人の町と木人の町のトビラ・・・\n\nあけてきちゃった:
Hehe... secretly, the doors of the Iron People town and the Wood People town...

I opened them...
It's a secret...
entries.ハツデンキ? ・・・ああ、それだ!\nこの小屋についてるエレベーターも\nそいつ:
The generator? ...Ah, that's it!
The elevator on this hut
ran on that too
entries.あんた、まだ ちいさいのに\nがんばるねぇ・・・\n\nあたしも\nへんないじを:
You're still so little,
and you try so hard...

Maybe I should
quit being stubborn about
my silly pride too...
entries.おれさぁ、\nむかし 川に入ろうとしたら・・・\n\nいきなり\nビリビリッてき:
I once tried to go into the river...

And suddenly, I got shocked by something...
entries.へへ・・・\nイタズラしたのバレちゃった・・・\n\nでも、みんながケンカしてる:
Hehe...
I got caught playing pranks...

But it's boring when everyone is fighting.
entries.ハツデンキは動いたが・・・\nこの国を囲むカベの中ではキカイは動かない・・・\n:
The generator ran, but...
inside the walls around this country the machines won't run...
So it's the Evil Pigs after all...
entries.みんなと\nなかなおり したいんだけどねぇ・・・\n\nまだ\nみんなギクシャク:
I'd like to make up
with everyone, but...

everyone's still
stiff with each other...
entries.ふるいけから、\nからくり村へ 行くのかい?\n・・・がんばれよ!:
From the Old Pond,
are you heading to Karakuri Village?
...Good luck!
entries.おにーちゃんなら\nこの国に魔法をかけた魔ブタも\nやっつけてくれるよね・・・:
Big brother, you'll defeat
the Evil Pig that put the spell on this country too,
right...
entries.動かない時計台: The Clock Tower That Won't Move
entries.鉄人の町\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
Iron People Town

Save?
Yes → △ No → ×
entries.なぁ・・・おめぇ、しってるかい?\n\nジャングルの横を流れる川を\n流れに逆ら:
Hey... do you know?

If you go upstream against the current in the river flowing next to Jungle, there's a waterfall, right?
entries.ああ・・・ときどき、\n丸太が落っこちてくる\nあの滝だろ・・・: Ah... that waterfall where logs sometimes fall, right?
entries.そうそう・・・なんでも、あの滝の上には\n大きな水たまりが あるらしいぜ: Oh yeah... I heard there's a big puddle on top of that waterfall.
entries.へぇーっ・・・\n一度見てみたいもんだなぁ\n\n・・・でも、こっちからは\nい:
Wow...
I'd really like to see that once.

...But I can't go there from here, can I?
entries.ああ、たぶんな・・・でも、\n始まりの村の ふるいけから\n行けるとか 聞いたこ:
Ah, probably not... but
I've heard you can get there
from the Old Pond in the Village of Beginnings...
entries.ん? なんだい\nおいらに何か用かい?\n\nおいら、こう見えても\nりっぱな鉄:
Huh? What's up with you?

I may look like this, but I'm a respectable ironworker...

If you want me to make something out of iron, come on over anytime...
entries.ん? なんだって?\n鉄のハグルマを作れるかって?\n\nはっはっはっ・・・\n:
Huh? What did you say?
Can you make iron gear?

Hahahaha...
I shouldn't make you laugh.

If it were up to me, I could do it in no time...

That's what I want to say, but...
Unfortunately, I'm out of iron materials right now.

...If you just bring me the materials, I'll make it for you right away.
entries.ん! これは いい材料だな\n・・・ちょっと まってな・・・: Hmm! This is good material... Wait a moment...
entries.ほらよ! おいらの手にかかれば\nこんなもんよ! さぁ、持っていきな: Here you go! With my hands, it's like this! Now, take it.
entries.しかし、鉄のハグルマなんて\n何につかうんだい?: But what would you use an iron gear for?
entries.おめぇさん・・・\n石の時計台を直したんだってな\n\n・・・まぁ、ものを直すっ:
You...
I heard you fixed the stone Clock Tower.

...Well, fixing things is a good thing... thank you.
entries.どうだった? 歯車は動いたかい?\n・・・・・・そうだろうな・・・\n\nおれは:
How'd it go? Did the gears move?
......Figured...

I came after you at Dr. Gantetsu's order...

Apparently fixing the gears alone doesn't get the Clock Tower moving...

To run the machine you need electricity
...Anyway, ask Dr. Gantetsu for the details...
entries.まさか ほんとうに\nキカイを動かしちまうなんてな\n\n・・・まったく たいし:
I can't believe you actually got the machine running

...You're really something
...Hm?

Oh, don't go into the gear room anymore...

Big gears are moving everywhere,
so it's very dangerous...
entries.・・・これが ハツデンキ・・・\nでも、どうやって 動かすんだろう?:
...So this is the generator...
But how do we get it running?
entries.・・・でも、そんなもの\nどこにあるんだよ: ...But where on earth would you find something like that?
entries.フーム・・・そうだな・・・\n石炭でもあれば・・・:
Hmm... I see...
If only we had some coal...
entries.石炭か・・・ん?\nまてよ・・・そういえば\n木人の町のどこかに あったような・:
Coal... hmm?
Wait a minute... now that I think about it, I think there was something like that somewhere in the town of Wood People...
entries.ほいさっ! ほいさっ!: Here you go! Here you go!
entries.ああ、キカイが熱で動かなくなったのさ\n・・・しかし、こまったな・・・: Ah, the machine has stopped working due to overheating... But this is a problem...
entries.そうかっ!\nじゃあ、おれの出番だな\n・・・ちょっとまってろよっ!:
Got it!
Well, it's my turn now... just wait a minute!
entries.これだこれだ・・・こいつを\nここんところに 取り付けて:
This is it, this is it...
attach this right here
entries.さぁーて・・・これで大丈夫だろ\n・・・そくせきの空冷ファンだ!:
All right... this should do it
...an instant air-cooling fan!
entries.それじゃあ もう一回やるぞ! それっ!: Alright, let's do it again! Here we go!
entries.・・・いやぁ あんたには\nほんとうに せわになったなぁ・・・\n\n・・・そう:
...Boy, I'm really in your debt...

...Come to think of it... I hear
you're traveling in pursuit of the Evil Pigs?
entries.ほら・・・\nこのジャングルに魔法をかけたヤツの\n封印ぶくろだ\n\n・・・役:
Here...
This is the Seal Bag from the guy who cast magic on this Jungle.

...I don't know if it'll be useful, but if you like it, feel free to take it...
entries.しかし・・・こんな少年が\n魔ブタと 戦ってるなんて\nすごいよな・・・:
But... it's amazing, a boy like this
fighting the Evil Pigs...
Really...
entries.魔ブタのことなら 滝の上にある\n大きな水たまりにいる 万年老人って人が\nくわ:
If it's the Evil Pigs you want to know about,
the 10,000-Year-Old Man who's in the big puddle
above the waterfall
is said to know the details...

Anyway, go meet him once.

But... you can only get above the waterfall
through the Old Pond in the Forest of Beginnings...

It's a bit of a detour,
so be careful on the way...
entries.万年老人!\n・・・あの イジワルじぃさんか?:
10,000-Year-Old Man!
...Is that the mean old man?
entries.おい おい・・・かりにも、\n時の老人のひとりだぞ・・・\n\nそんなことはない:
Hey, hey...
he's one of the Old Men of Time, after all...

Not at all, I'd say... probably
Anyway, go meet him once
entries.ふるいけをぬけるトビラには \nカギがかかっているからな・・・\n\nほら、これ:
The door out of the Old Pond
is locked...

Here, take this
— the Old Pond Key...
entries.老木の丘からイカダにでも のれば\nシーフマンションまで戻れるはずだ・・・\n\:
If you take a raft from Old Tree Hill,
you should be able to get back to Thief Mansion...

I'll leave one at the workshop,
so take it with you
entries.・・・力を合わせれば・・・\n何とかなるもんだな・・・:
...If we work together...
We can make it work somehow...
entries.・・・おれたち・・・どうして\nケンカしてたんだろう・・・: ...We... I wonder why we were fighting...
entries.・・・きっと あのカベのせいじゃないかな・・・\nむかしは おれたち もっとなか:
...Maybe it's because of that wall...
Back in the day, we were much closer friends...
entries.・・・・・・う〜〜〜ん・・・・・\n\n鉄の城も こうなっちまうと \nどうしよ:
・・・・・・Hmm...

Even an iron castle can't be saved once it's like this...

......Hmmmm.....

Once the Iron Castle is like this,
there's nothing to be done...

......Hmmmm.....Hm?
...What? You were listening... eh?

...It's true, the machine room is beyond this door...
but look, as you can see...
there's no way to open it like this...

...We left it alone for so long...
and in the end even the generator inside stopped,
and now it's come to this...

Honestly, it's a disgrace to the name of the Land of Civilization...
entries.・・・こんなに さびついてたらなぁ・・・\n押しても 引いてもビクともしねぇや:
...It's rusted so badly...
it won't budge whether you push or pull
entries.ガンテツ?\n・・・ああ、あのへんくつの\nガンテツ博土かい?\n\n博土なら:
Gantetsu?
...Oh, you mean the crotchety
Dr. Gantetsu?

The doctor went back to his hut
...you know, the one in the middle
you can get to by that lift
entries.・・・地下迷宮の魔ブタゲートか・・・\nほかならぬトンバのたのみだ\n・・・やっ:
...The Evil Pig Gate in the Underground Maze...
For Tomba, no less...
...I'll do it!
entries.・・・ふん! 見なれないカオだな・・・\nこの先には 鉄の城があるんだが・・・\:
...Hmph! What an unfamiliar face...
Beyond here lies the Iron Castle...
If you don't have any particular business, you should go home...

Hmm?
Me? My name is Gantetsu...

Well, if you're useful to this country, I'll lend you my strength...
entries.・・・まさか、お前さんみたいな少年が\n時計台を直してしまうとはな・・・\nいや:
...To think a boy like you
would fix the Clock Tower...
No, I'm sorry for the rude

things I said until now...
And...
entries.お前さんが せっかく直してくれた\n時計台だが・・・\n\nあれを本当に動かすに:
The Clock Tower you were kind enough to fix...

To make it really run,
the generator in the Iron Castle ahead
has to be started...

But... there's one
problem...

Well, first go to the Iron Castle
and see for yourself...
entries.よぉ・・・開かないトビラは 見てきたかい?\n・・・あれは 古いトビラでな・・・:
Hey... have you seen the door that won't open?
...That's an old door...

You'd probably have to use a bomb to blow it away before you could even get inside...
entries.バクダンの作り方?\n・・・はあっ!はあっ!はっ!\n・・・おいおい、本気にした:
How to make a bomb?
...Hah! Hah! Hah!
...Hey, did you really take this seriously?

He's such an honest guy...
Well, to be fair, no one's ever gone that far before...

...Alright! Let's give it a try!
In exchange... there are a few things I'd like you to gather for me...
entries.バクダンを作るためには まず、\nこの小屋の そうちを動かすために\n少しの電気:
To make a bomb, first of all,
the equipment in this hut needs
a little electricity to run...

An electric eel from the jungle
should be enough for that...

And the black water that the bomb is made from...
bring both here once you have them... I'm counting on you!
entries.ちょっとまった!\n電気ウナギを素手でつかまえる気か?\n\n・・・まったく あ:
Wait a minute!
Are you trying to catch an electric eel with your bare hands?

...What a hasty person you are...
Here, take this...
entries.ん!\n二つとも そろったようだな・・・\nでは、材料は あずかろう・・・:
Hm!
Looks like you have both...
Then I'll take the materials.
entries.・・・よぉしっ! これでバクダンの素を\n作ることができるぞ!\n・・・そうだ!:
...All right! Now I can make
the bomb powder!
...Oh, that's right!

While I'm at it,
while I make the bomb powder,
could you fetch a coconut?

I'm sure there's one on one of the trees in the jungle...

If we pack the bomb powder into the coconut shell,
it'll be finished, all nice and tidy!
entries.おおっ!\nやっときたか・・・じゃあ、\nヤシの実をあずかろうか・・・:
Oh!
You made it at last...
Then let me take the coconut...
entries.このバクダンの素を\nヤシのカラにつめてと\n・・・よし、完成だ!!:
Pack this bomb powder
into the coconut shell, and
...there, it's finished!!
entries.ん?\n何だ まだバクダンがほしいのか?\n\nヤシの実さえあれば\nいくつでも:
Huh?
What? You still want bombs?

If you have coconuts, I'll make as many as you want...
entries.うーん・・・やっぱりダメか\n・・・キミってスゴイな・・・: Hmm... I guess it's still no good... You're amazing...
entries.上に行きたいのかい?・・・\nだったら この小屋に入りなよ:
Do you want to go up? ...
Then enter this hut.
entries.よくきたね・・・\nここは鉄人の町って言うんだ・・・:
Welcome...
this is called the Iron People's town...
entries.丈夫で ながもち・・・\nやっぱ 鉄って いいよなぁー:
Strong and durable...
I guess iron really is great, huh?
entries.あたい 思うんだけどさぁ・・・\nどうして みんな いがみあうんだろ?・・・\n:
I wonder...
why does everyone quarrel?...
I don't like it...
entries.どいつもこいつも\n木だの石だの\nやわなこと 言いやがって・・・\n\n男は鉄:
Every last one of them
goes on about wood and stone
with such wimpy talk...

A man is iron!
What else is there?
entries.おれをめじるしにして\nまっすぐ下に行けば 出口だ・・・\nこっちからじゃ わか:
Use me as a landmark
and go straight down for the exit...
Hard to tell from this side, isn't it?
entries.・・・むかしは 手で回さなくても\nキカイでリフトが動いたんだけどなぁ・・・:
...In the old days the lift
ran by machine without turning it by hand...
entries.リフトにのって\nそこの真ん中の道を上に行けば\n鉄の城があるんだけど・・・:
Take the lift
and go up the middle road over there,
and there's an Iron Castle...
entries.もうっ・・・あのガンテツおやじ・・・\nどうして鉄の城に行かしてくれないのよ・・:
Ugh... that Gantetsu old man...
Why won't you let me go to the Iron Castle...?
entries.この国にも\n魔ブタの魔法がかかってるんだ・・・\nでも・・・どうしようもないよ:
This country is under
the Evil Pig's magic too...
But... there's nothing we can do...
entries.何か おさがしかな?・・・\nもし、鉄で何か作りたいのなら・・・\nそこのリフト:
Is there something you're looking for?...
If you want to make something out of iron...
Go to that lift cabin over there.
entries.キミ・・・時計台 直したんだって?\nすごいなぁ・・・\n\nいまの この国じゃ:
You... did you fix Clock Tower?
That's amazing...

It's unthinkable in this country right now...
entries.石人の時計台が鉄のハグルマで\nなおったんだって?・・・\n\nえっ? 動かない:
I heard the Stone People's Clock Tower got fixed with iron gears?...

Huh? It doesn't run?...
I see...
entries.鉄の城のトビラ?・・・\n\nアハハハ・・・\nそんなの\nこわせるハズないでし:
The door of the Iron Castle?...

Ahahaha...
there's no way
you could break that...
entries.おまえさん・・・\n泳ぎは とくいですかな?・・・\n\nわしは\nおもいっきり:
You...
Are you good at swimming?...

As for me,
I can't swim a stroke...
entries.おいらも\nほんとうは むねをはって・・・\n\nここは文明の国です!って\n言:
Me too,
I really want to stand tall...

and say, "This is the Land of Civilization!"
entries.キ、キミ・・・\nハツデンキまで直しちゃったの?・・・\nす、すごすぎるよ・・・:
Y-you...
You even fixed the generator?...
T-that's too amazing...
entries.木と石と鉄かぁ・・・\nやっぱ バランスが 大事だよな:
Wood, stone, and iron...
Balance really is important, isn't it?
entries.万年のじぃさんに\n会いに行くんだって・・・\nところで イカダは持ってるのかい:
I hear you're going to see
the 10,000-Year-Old Man...
By the way, do you have a raft?
entries.ふーん・・・あんたスゴイんだ・・・\nバカにして悪かったね\nあやまるから また:
Hmm... you're something...
Sorry for making fun of you
I apologize, so come play again
entries.文明の国\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→△ いいえ→×:
Land of Civilization

Save?
Yes → △  No → ×
entries.まっすぐ 鉄の城\nみぎ 時計台\nひだり 加工場:
Straight ahead: Iron Castle
Right: Clock Tower
Left: Workshop
entries.・・・ひろいなぁ・・・\n前の石人の町の4倍いじょう\nあるんだって・・・:
...It's big...
they say it's more than four times
the old Stone People's town...
entries.国の中を の〜んびり おさんぽ・・・\n・・・いいねぇ・・・:
Walking leisurely through the country...
...How nice...
entries.・・・ボクも木のおうちに\nすみたいなぁ・・・:
...I'd like to live in a wooden house
too...
entries.・・・いま、鉄の城ってのを\n見てきたんだけど・・・\nコシぬかしちゃったよ:
...I just went to see
the Iron Castle...
and I was bowled over
entries.もう一度 みんなで一つの国をつくれるなんて・・・\nこれも み〜んな トンバのお:
To think we can make one country together again...
it's all thanks to Tomba...
entries.ひさしぶりだなぁ トンバ・・・\nどうだい? おれたちの新しい町は?:
It's been a while, Tomba...
How's it? Our new town?
entries.・・・こ・・・この・・・鉄の冷たい\nかんしょくが 何とも・・・:
...Th-this... the cold feel
of the iron... is really something...
entries.木づくりってのも あったかみがあって\nなかなかイイもんだなぁ・・・: Making wood also has a warmth to it, and it's quite nice...
entries.時計台も みんなで お色直ししたんだぜ・・・\n一度、見てってくれよ:
We all gave the Clock Tower a makeover, too...
Come and see it sometime
entries.木・石・鉄・・・それぞれの素材をいかすことが\n大事だよな・・・\nま、ようは:
Wood, stone, iron... it's important to make use of each material, right?
Well, basically, it's about how you use things.
entries.魔ブタがカベをつくっただけで\nみんなの気持ちがバラバラになっちまうなんて\n・:
That the Evil Pigs just building a wall
could tear everyone's feelings apart...
...it's scary
entries.ほかにも 魔ブタに魔法をかけられた所って\nあるんだろ?・・・:
There must be other places
the Evil Pigs put under a spell, right?...
entries.んっ? \nジュースのみたいのか?\n\n・・・ちがう? \n最後の魔ブタをこら:
Hm?
You want some juice?

...No?
You're going to punish the last Evil Pig!?
All right! I'm coming too!
entries.あら?\n・・・・・・あらあらあらあらあらっ!\n\n・・・・・・かわいいボウヤ:
Oh?
......Oh my, oh my, oh my, oh my, oh my!

......What a cute little boy!

Me?
...I'm Mizuno... Mizuno the witch!
entries.・・・な〜に?\nボウヤも魔法のドロップがほしいの?\n\nごめんねぇ・・・\n:
...What's this?
You want some magic candy too, little boy?

I'm sorry...

I can't spare a hand right now...
Will you do it yourself?

Look, stand in front of the big pot there
and just use the items you want as ingredients...
entries.・・・・・・しっかし\n・・・こまったなぁ・・・\n・・・どこに おきわすれたの:
......Still...
...what a mess...
...where did I leave them...

...But... who forgets such a thing?
...My precious crystal balls...
and three of them!!

...Maybe it was the Watch Tower
I went to before...?
entries.あ〜あ・・・・・・\nせっかく 3つの水晶と見えないカガミで・・・\nアレを作ろ:
Aww......
And I was going to use the three crystals and the Dirty Mirror...
to make That Thing...
entries.あら?\n・・・・・・あらあらあらあらあらっ!\n\n・・・これよ これっ!\n:
Oh?
......Oh my, oh my, oh my, oh my, oh my!

...These! These!
......Why do you have them, little boy?

...But you've saved me... thank you, little boy
...All right...
now at last I can make That Thing...

......Oh,
you seem interested too, little boy?

...Then come back
in a little while...
...It shouldn't take long...
entries.きた きたっ!\n待ってたよ・・・ほら、これがウワサのアレ・・・\n魔法のカガミ:
Here it comes!
I've been waiting for this... Look, this is the rumored thing...
It's the Magic Mirror!
entries.・・・・・・・・・・ポンッ!\n・・・ほ〜ら できた・・・\n\nふたつの道具の:
......Pop!
...There, it's done...

The Grapple Jack, with the properties of both tools,
is complete!
entries.このカガミはさぁ・・・スゴイんだよ・・・\nなんと!\n\n道具をパワーアップし:
This mirror is amazing...
Get this!

It powers up tools...
Little boy... don't you have something?
entries.な〜んだ いいもの持ってるじゃない・・・\nふーん・・・グルドカとグルピンねぇ・:
Oh, you have something good...
Hmm... Blackjack and Grapple, huh...

I'm seeing this for the first time too...
Alright, I'll reflect this onto the mirror...
...............

...............
...............
entries.ちなみに・・・魔法のカガミは\nアタシにしか使えないんだけど・・・\n・・・まぁ:
By the way... the Magic Mirror
can only be used by me...
...Well, keep it as a souvenir...
entries.は・・・は・・・\nはぁ〜れた そらぁ〜・・・\n\nあら?\n・・・なおった!:
Ha... ha...
Ha-aah-choo, there!...

Oh?
...It's cured!?...

...Little boy...
You even brought medicine for me...

......Could it be, you've fallen for me?
...Just kidding, just kidding!

But you really saved me...
Hearing one sneeze and
bringing me cold medicine...

Impressive...
Here!
It's nothing much, but take it
entries.こんなトコで 寄り道してていーのかい?: Is it okay to take a detour at a place like this?
entries.・・・な〜に?\nボウヤも魔法のドロップがほしいの?\n・・・あまいねぇ〜\n\:
...What's this?
You want magic candy too, little boy?
...How naive~

You need these ingredients
to make candy!!

The Biting Grass Flower, of course,
and the Silver Powder,
and the Black Syrup is a must...

The Kokka Claw gives a nice flavor,
and I suppose the Butamushi Thorn is needed too,
and the Needlegator Fang is the secret ingredient!

Now, stand in front of that big pot over there
and put in the ingredient items.
entries.まだ 材料が たりないみたい・・・\nあと:
It looks like there are still ingredients missing...
You also need
entries.おお、おまえ、ドワーフのことばわかるか!?\nドワーフ、とてもこまってる・・・\:
Oh, you understand the Dwarf language!?
The dwarves are in great trouble...

...The truth is... this Dwarf Forest
is under the Evil Pig's magic...
The flowers withered, and the trees changed their shape...

Just now, seven of our friends
were swallowed up by plants in the forest
and went missing...

They must be inside one of the big plants,
or caught by spores
and unable to move...

Quickly we opened the hut in the forest
and the door near the village entrance,
and went to keep watch deep in the forest...

...If you don't find our friends,
they won't let you through
to the back of the forest...
entries.・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・\nじつは、こどもがひとり・・・\n森:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...
entries.もう、森のおくを\n見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・\n自由に通ってくだされ・・・:
There's no need to guard
the back of the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.よぉ・・・\nお前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・\n\nどうだい?\nオレと ひと:
Hey...
I've been waiting
for you to come...

How about it?
Want to have a match with me?

The truth is, I hid a treasure
at the top of the Watch Tower up ahead.
So here's the deal,

start from the bottom of the Watch Tower,
and if you reach the treasure before I do,
the treasure is yours...

How about it, sounds fun, right?
Well... here I go!
entries.うわ〜 空に飛んでるトリまで \nヤキトリに見えるぅぅぅぅ・・・ \n\nほぁ・:
Whoa~ even the birds flying in the sky
look like yakitori...

Huh... did you want something?

Sorry, I'm starving,
so everything looks like food right now,
you'd better keep away...

Aww, isn't there some kind person
who'd share some filling food with me...
entries.おおお! しんせつな人は\nいがいと近くに いるんだなあ!!\n\nおっとっと:
Oh wow!
Kind people can be surprisingly close by!!

Whoa, whoa, before I eat, I should thank you first,
thanks for helping me!

I'm Taro...
Oh, right, you can have this...
Here, a Cheese Fruit
entries.何かこまった事があれば、\nいつでも た・す・け・て\n・・・くれよ!!:
If you ever have any trouble,
anytime, h-e-l-p
...me out, okay!!
entries.旅の人!\n\nここに来る途中\nヤンと言う子供に会いませんでした?\n\nじつ:
Traveler!

On your way here, did you meet a child called Yan?

The thing is, he's my son...
and he's a bit of a silly boy...

Once he hides in hide-and-seek,
he won't come home until he's found.

He must be hungry by now...
Traveler, would you find Yan
and deliver this to him?
entries.かならず 息子に届けてくださいよ!!\n途中でつまみ食いしないように・・・たのみ:
Please be sure to deliver this to my son!!
Don't snack on it along the way... I'm counting on you.
entries.あなたの事は 息子のヤンから聞いてます\nトンバさんでしょ・・・\n\nあなたが:
I've heard about you from my son Yan.
You're Tomba, aren't you...

Thanks to you finding Yan,
who was hiding on your journey,
he's back in the village now.

If you hadn't found him...
Yan would probably still be
playing hide-and-seek by himself...

Thank you so much...
entries.またヤンが かくれんぼを始めたら、\nはやめに 見つけてやってくださいね・・・:
If Yan starts playing hide-and-seek again,
please find him quickly...
entries.そのべんとうは・・・\nとうさんに会ったんだね\nわざわざ 届けてくれてありがと:
That lunch box...
you met Dad, didn't you
Thanks for going out of your way to bring it

But you can have it.
I'm not hungry

Take this too, if you like
It's nothing much... Well, bye~!
entries.え・・・な、なんだって!!\nオイラのべんとうを 食べちゃったのか?\n\nオイ:
Eh... w-what!!
You ate my lunch box?

Hey, hey, I'm kidding...
Don't worry about it!

Dad's lunch boxes are delicious, after all
Well, I'm off... bye-bye!
entries.へぇ・・・\nここを 見つけるなんて たいしたものね・・・\nここは かくれ里っ:
Wow...
Finding this place is quite something...
This place is called the Hidden Village
entries.ここの れんちゅうは \nかくれるのが だいすきでのぅ・・・\n\nそうじゃ、ヤ:
Everyone here
loves to hide, you know...

Oh, right, have you met Yan yet?
entries.ここのチョウヅカには 金の・・・\n何とかって言うめずらしいものを\n守ってるら:
I hear the Chozuka here
guards a rare gold...
something-or-other.
entries.やぁ!キミが来るのを待ってたんだ\n\n・・・はじめて出会ったのをいれて\n・・:
Hey! I was waiting for you to come

...Counting the first time we met,
...I've hidden five times

and you found me every time... but
it was fun!

Then here's some prime information
...somewhere on this continent

there's supposedly a place called
the Million Tower...

Huh? Where is it?
You have to find that out yourself!

But you know... if you search blindly,
you'll never find it...

Certain conditions have to be met...
And this is a present from me!

I'm sure it'll come in handy!
entries.風になりたい: I want to become the wind.
entries.つかわなくてよい: You don't have to use it.

A newly hatched chick
cheeping away
entries.かえり道をわすれたカエル:

Blast ahead!
Pants that make you move even faster

A handy map

entries.めずらしいつぼだが われている\nさいきんわれたようだ:

entries.はじめから はいている\nパンツ:
The pants you've worn

A reliable item

A ball marked 8
that the 10,000-Year-Old Man asked for
entries.万年老人から たのまれた\n9とかかれた 玉:
A ball marked 9
that the 10,000-Year-Old Man asked for
entries.万年老人から たのまれた\n10とかかれた 玉:
A ball marked 10
that the 10,000-Year-Old Man asked for
entries.レースで3位になるともらえる\nふつうのメダル:
An ordinary medal
for finishing third in a race
entries.レースで2位になるともらえる\nちょっとジマンのメダル:
A medal to be a little proud of,
for finishing second in a race
entries.レースでゆうしょうするともらえる\nすばらしいメダル:
A splendid medal
for winning a race
entries.三姉妹あての\nふしぎな内容の手紙:
A letter with a mysterious message
addressed to the three sisters
entries.イカダをつくるには、\nもってこいの 木材:
Lumber just right
for building a raft
entries.流れに沿って流れる乗り物\n海は無理だが、川ならOK!:
A vehicle that floats along with the current
— no good on the sea, but a river is fine!
entries.黄金の5大アイテムの一つ\nカレハチョウが運んでくれた:
One of the Five Great Golden Items
— the Leaf Butterfly brought it
entries.どこかにあるという、黄金のフルーツ: The golden fruit that is said to be somewhere
entries.ことさらにゴージャスな、金色に咲いた花:

that bloomed in gold
entries.たべればきっと つよくなれる: Eat it and you're sure to get stronger
entries.土をほるために とてもむいている どうぐ:
A tool well suited
for digging the earth

Equip it on the item screen to bring out the fire ability
Use the ability with the attack button

Once used, you can't make the next attack
until the meter fills up...

Equip it on the item screen to bring out the water ability
Use the ability with the attack button

Once used, you can't make the next attack
until the meter fills up...

You can soar into the sky, but your defense is low
Normal attacks are possible while moving
entries.能力開花の やくにたつ?: Could it help bring out an ability?

Jet-black syrup.

The pointed claw of the monster bird Kokka

A very painful Butamushi thorn
can be mixed in
entries.ハリゲーターのキバは きちょうひん: The Needlegator's fang is a rare find
entries.きけんな草に さいた めずらしい花:
A rare flower
that bloomed on a dangerous plant
entries.ビリビリくる! デンキのもと?:
It gives you a jolt!
The source of electricity?
entries.黒い水はふしぎな水 きけんぶつ: Black water is mysterious water, a hazardous substance
entries.5大アイテムのひとつ: One of the five great items

entries.ヤシの実を空っぽにして なにかをつめると\nエキサイティング:
Empty out a coconut and stuff something in it
— exciting
entries.タイコの原料 気持ちの良い音を\n鳴らしてくれる:
Material for a drum.
It makes a pleasant sound
entries.ついに手に入れた! これこそ\nジィちゃんの形見の腕輪!:
Finally got it! This is it,
Grandpa's keepsake bracelet!
entries.死神の実を潰すためには\nこれなしでは不可能:
Impossible to crush the Reaper Fruit
without this
entries.タイコの原料 かたくて いい音がでる:
Material for a drum.
Hard, and makes a good sound
entries.タイコの原料 木と皮を はりつけることができる:
Material for a drum.
Lets you glue wood and hide together
entries.いつでも どこでも 1000年老人のもとへ\n帰ることが!:
Any time, anywhere,
you can go back to the 1,000-Year-Old Man!
entries.マサカリ族にとって かけがえのない タイコ:
A drum that's irreplaceable
to the Masakari tribe
entries.どこかにいるらしい 万能魚\nエサもふつうじゃない:
The Almighty Fish said to be somewhere
— and its bait is no ordinary bait
entries.なにのカギか、 まったくわからない:
I have no idea
what this is a key to
entries.いくらかじってもなくならない\n笑いも泣きも じゆうじざい:
However much you nibble it, it never runs out
laugh or cry as you please
entries.太古からいる きゅうきょくの魚\nたべると人を超える?:
An ancient, ultimate fish
eat it and you might go beyond human?
entries.顔面フラワーから こぼれおちた ナミダ:
A tear that dropped
from a Face Flower
entries.小さくても いい音がひびく タイコ:
A drum that rings out nicely
even though it's small
entries.ひとふり かけると つぼみも花ひらく\nめずらしい粉:
A rare powder:
sprinkle a pinch and even buds bloom
entries.バナナのおいしさが たっぷりの\nあま〜いジュース:
A sweet juice
packed with the goodness of bananas
entries.きれいに たたまれたパンツ\nだれかが こまっているかも:
A neatly folded pair of pants
— someone might be in need of them
entries.魔女が忘れた きれいな水晶:
A beautiful crystal
the Witch forgot
entries.カシラからの あずかり物を\nなくしちゃった!!:
I lost what the Boss
entrusted to me!!
entries.うっかり わすれた\n大事な あずかり物:
Something important
I was entrusted with
and carelessly forgot
entries.いくらかじってもなくならない\nいつでも笑い泣きを なくせる:
However much you nibble it, it never runs out
cures laughing and crying at any time
entries.この世には、もえる石もあるらしい:
Apparently there are stones in this world
that burn
entries.ゆうがな 貝の首飾り \nトンバには にあいそうもない?:
An elegant seashell necklace
— it doesn't look like it suits Tomba?
entries.さきがヘンテコにまがった、\nあやしいハリガネ:
A suspicious wire
with a strangely bent tip
entries.かたい金属でつくられた、ハリガネ: A wire made of hard metal
entries.いつでも どこでも\n万年老人にあえる:
Any time, anywhere
you can meet the 10,000-Year-Old Man
entries.いつでも どこからでも \n地下の億年老人のところへ!:
Any time, from anywhere,
to the 100-Million-Year-Old Man underground!
entries.カゼをひいたら、はやめにクスリをのもう: If you catch a cold, take medicine early
entries.ヤンのための、とくせい弁当: A special lunch box for Yan
entries.さびてきたない、よくわからないカギ:
A rusty, dirty key
nobody can quite make out
entries.高山にさくという、やくそう\nケガを早く治す:
A medicinal herb said to bloom on high mountains
heals injuries quickly
entries.いちどたべると、一生わすれない\nとっても おいしい木の実:
Eat it once and you'll never forget it
— a delicious fruit
entries.これをたべると、みんな元気で暮らせる: Eat this and everyone will live healthy lives
entries.コマブタにとられた うでわを\nもとめて たびだつ:
Setting off to get back the bracelet
the Koma Buta took
entries.ものしりな100年老人に\n会いに行く:
Going to meet the all-knowing
100-Year-Old Man
entries.行く手をはばむ\nきりを はらす:
Clear the fog
blocking the way ahead
entries.サクのむこうに のびる\nデコボコ道:
A bumpy road
stretching past the fence
entries.まどから のぞいている人と\n話しをした:
Talked with the person
peeking out the window
entries.かくれていた人の\nなまえを しった:
Learned the name
of the person who was hiding
entries.魔ブタが来たときの\n話しをきいた:
Heard the story
of when the Evil Pigs came
entries.森でまいごになった\nこどもを さがす:
Find the child who got lost
in the forest
entries.何かの たねを\nひろう: Pick up some kind of seed
entries.APをためると\nいいものが手に入る:
Save up AP
and you'll get something good
entries.森でいなくなった ドワーフたちを さがす:
Find the Dwarves
who went missing in the forest
entries.きこりドワーフに\n木を きってもらう:
Have the lumberjack Dwarf
cut down a tree
entries.魔女がわすれていった\n3つの 水晶・・・:
The three crystals
the Witch left behind...
entries.おおどろぼうが だっそうしようと\nしたらしいが・・・?:
The Great Thief supposedly
tried to escape, but...?
entries.遠くの 景色を見わたす: Look out over the distant scenery
entries.かくれていた とまっている\nエレベーター:
A hidden elevator
that has stopped
entries.長老は、大トリの山へ\n行けといった・・・:
The Elder told me to go
to the Great Bird's mountain...
entries.めぐみさまを復活させると\n何かがおこる:
Revive Lady Megumi
and something will happen
entries.まえに 見たような やしき・・・\nどこでだろう?:
A mansion I've seen before...
Where was it?
entries.魔ブタを 封印ぶくろに封じてしまう: Seal the Evil Pig in a Seal Bag
entries.どこに つながっているか\nわからない パイプ:
A pipe that leads
who knows where
entries.コインは どこからカゼに\n飛ばされて きたのか・・・?:
Where did the coins come from,
blown here by the wind...?
entries.嵐の山にいる 大トリに\nあいに行く:
Go see the Great Bird
on the stormy mountain
entries.行く手を ふさぐ マサカリ族に\nどいてもらう:
Get the Masakari tribe blocking the way
to move aside
entries.キノコの森に すむという\n怪物と たたかう:
Fight the monster said to live
in the Mushroom Forest
entries.しょくぶつを からせてしまう\n実を みんな つぶす:
Crush all the fruits
that wither plants
entries.お花のたねを 畑にまいて\nきれいな お花畑にする:
Sow flower seeds in the field
to make a beautiful flower garden
entries.ナミダは 復活に かかせないの?: Are Tears essential for the revival?
entries.笑いのトビラは 笑っている人にしか\nひらかない:
The Door of Laughter opens
only for someone who is laughing
entries.泣きのトビラは 泣いている人にしか\nひらかない:
The Door of Tears opens
only for someone who is crying
entries.泣きやみたくても やめられない:
I want to stop crying,
but I can't
entries.よく当る 赤い占い師に会う:
Meet the Red Fortune Teller
who is often right
entries.APが おおいほど\nいいアイテムが 手に入る:
The more AP you have,
the better the item you get
entries.コレクターが ほしがる物をあつめると\nとてもいい アイテムがもらえる:
Collect what the Collector wants
and you'll get a really good item
entries.シーフマンションをこえて\nポンプを しゅうりする:
Get past Thief Mansion
and repair the pump
entries.湖への きけんな道を かけぬける:
Run through the dangerous road
to the lake
entries.トビラにあう ちいさなカギを手に入れる:
Get the small key
that fits the door
entries.ネズミに かえられた\n人たちを もどしてあげる:
Turn the people
who were changed into mice back
entries.魔ブタを 封印ぶくろに 封じる: Seal the Evil Pig in a Seal Bag
entries.トビラにあう 大きなカギを 手に入れる:
Get the big key
that fits the door
entries.絵のパーツを すべてあつめると\nアイテムが手に入る:
Collect all the picture pieces
and you'll get an item
entries.封印をといて 1000年老人の\nはなしをきく:
Break the seal and listen to
the 1,000-Year-Old Man's story
entries.族長が なくしたヤリを さがす:
Find the spear
the Chief lost
entries.ものしりの 老木に 会いにいく: Go meet the all-knowing Old Tree
entries.すべてのポンプ岩には ヒミツがある: Every Pump Rock has a secret
entries.サンタの きげんをとると\nあたらしいことを おしえてくれる:
Humor Santa
and he'll teach you something new
entries.らくがき岩の もじを かいどくする:
Decipher the writing
on the Graffiti Rock
entries.動かなくなった時計台の\n時計を動かす:
Get the stopped clock
of the Clock Tower running again
entries.ぬすまれた 封印ぶくろを さがしだす: Track down the stolen Seal Bag
entries.サンタにボウシをとられた\n石人がこまっている:
The Stone Person whose hat
Santa took is in trouble
entries.動きだした 地下のせかい:
The underground world
has started moving
entries.魔ブタを 封印ぶくろに封じる: Seal the Evil Pig in a Seal Bag
entries.盗賊のカシラも モノわすれ?: Is the Thieves' Boss forgetful too?
entries.おなかを すかせたタロウに\nたべものを あげる:
Give food to Taro,
who is hungry
entries.鉄のクルマは \nどうやって動かすのだろう?:
How do you make
the iron car go?
entries.どうぶつのケガなら すぐになおるらしい:
Apparently animals' injuries
heal right away
entries.一度食べると 忘れられない 木の実が\nどこかに あるらしい・・・:
Somewhere there's supposedly a fruit
you can never forget once you eat it...
entries.ずっと元気で暮らせる 海草が\n流れつく ところは?:
Where does the seaweed that keeps you
healthy forever wash ashore?
entries.緑の占い師の 話しをきく: Listen to the Green Fortune Teller
entries.かるくて うきあがってしまう: So light that it floats right up
entries.こわれた橋で あしどめ: Held up by the broken bridge
entries.ハリのとまった 時計: A clock whose hands have stopped
entries.ひらかない カギ穴のついた トビラ:
A door with a keyhole
that won't open
entries.ビクともしない サビついたトビラ: A rusted door that won't budge
entries.とっても かわいい 魔女が\nいるらしい・・・: Apparently there's a really cute witch...
entries.大きな力で ふきとばそう: Blow it away with great power
entries.この犬には、何か とくべつな\n力が あるらしい・・・:
This dog apparently
has some special power...
entries.魔女が とっても こまっている?: Is the Witch in real trouble?
entries.パクリとかじれば もとどおり: One bite and it's good as new
entries.さきへ行くには 泳ぐしかない!: The only way ahead is to swim!
entries.かわったサカナ たべられるの?: Can you eat a strange fish?
entries.3つのアイテムを調合して\n魔法の ドロップをつくろう!:
Mix three items
to make a magic candy!
entries.モトクロスコースの ゴール!: The goal of the motocross course!
entries.魔ブタを封印ぶくろに封じる: Seal the Evil Pig in a Seal Bag
entries.カゼをひいたら 早めの・・・: If you catch a cold, early...
entries.3位のきろくを こえた めいよのメダル:
A medal of honor for beating
the 3rd-place record
entries.2位のきろくを こえた めいよのメダル:
A medal of honor for beating
the 2nd-place record
entries.トップを こえた すばらしいメダル:
A wonderful medal
for beating the top record
entries.おもさが 分ける? すすむ道:
A path that divides by weight?
The road ahead
entries.あわてず さわがず 出口をさがせ!!:
Don't panic, don't make a fuss —
find the exit!!
entries.魔力がきえて 3つのまちが ひとつになる:
The magic fades and the three towns
become one
entries.億年老人のねがいは 魔ブタを封印すること:
The 100-Million-Year-Old Man's wish
is to seal the Evil Pig
entries.サァ! 道なき 道を いこう:
Come on! Let's take
the road with no road
entries.じぶんを しりたいときは 占い師!:
When you want to know yourself,
see a fortune teller!
entries.何か のりものが あれば・・・: If only there were some kind of vehicle...
entries.かくれんぼがすきな 息子よ\nハラは へっていないか?:
My son who loves hide-and-seek,
aren't you hungry?
entries.見えそうで 見えない 水のそこ:
The bottom of the water,
almost visible but not quite
entries.魔力は どこから うまれるの?: Where does magic power come from?
entries.ひとりは ダメなら みんなで やろう!:
If one can't do it alone,
let's all do it together!
entries.どうして? 8つめの封印ぶくろが あった:
Why? There was an
eighth Seal Bag
entries.魔ブタの中の 魔ブタ!!: An Evil Pig inside an Evil Pig!!
entries.どこかにあるの? 本当の宝物: Is there a real treasure somewhere?
entries.ミリオンって いくつだっけ?: How much is a million, again?
entries.気がつけば みんな しあわせ!: Before you know it, everyone is happy!
entries.サルのサンタは おなかが すいているようだ\nなにか たべものを さがしてこよう:
Santa the monkey seems hungry
Shall I go look for some food?
entries.コマブタが小さくなって マゴブタ?:
The Koma Buta shrank —
a Mago Buta?
entries.魔ブタを 封じる力を持つ\n封印ぶくろ:
A Seal Bag with the power
to seal Evil Pigs
entries.あぶない花が きれいな花を さかせる:
A dangerous flower
blooms a pretty flower
entries.嵐が強くて トビラが あけられない:
The storm is so strong
the door can't be opened
entries.ヨボヨボ大トリに げんきをあげる:
Give some pep to
the feeble Great Bird
entries.ゆくてを さえぎる \n炎をしずめなくっちゃ!:
I have to put out the flames
blocking the way!
entries.アジトを なくした とうぞく: The thieves who lost their hideout
entries.みんなを 笑わせる 笑がお\nできるかな?:
Can you make a smiling face
that makes everyone laugh?
entries.かなしさを つたえる 泣きがお\nできるかな?:
Can you make a crying face
that conveys sadness?
entries.たき火から あま〜い かおりが\nただよってくる:
A sweet smell is drifting
from the campfire
entries.なぞの力をもつ 伝説のチョウ:
The legendary butterfly
with a mysterious power
entries.くらくなって 何も見えない: It's dark and I can't see anything
entries.ブクブクと おとをたてて しずんでいく\n大きなタル:
A big barrel sinking
with a gurgling sound
entries.てっぺんまで カケッこ どっちが はやい?:
A race to the top —
who's faster?
entries.何もうつらないほど よごれたカガミ:
A mirror so dirty
it reflects nothing
entries.見はりがいる宝箱 なかには何が・・・?:
A treasure chest with a guard —
what's inside...?
entries.たかく のぼれば よく見える:
The higher you climb,
the better you can see
entries.パクリとカジれば 泣き 笑い:
One bite makes you cry,
then laugh
entries.2つをあわせると 見たことない物が あらわれる:
Combine the two and something
you've never seen appears
entries.なにかをなくして こまってる: I lost something and I'm in trouble
entries.またもや 忘れて こまってる・・・:
Forgot something again,
and in trouble...
entries.だれにも言えない\nたいへんな 悩みごと・・・:
A terrible worry
I can't tell anyone...
entries.またも みうしなった\n大事な あずかり物:
The important item I was entrusted with
— lost sight of again

messages.translation:
Is this your first time on this land?

I used to live here, but things seem to have changed somehow.

I don't know what's going on, but if there's something you want to know, there's a cabin way up ahead —

an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there. Go meet him and ask.

But it's gotten dangerous around here too, so be careful.

Oh, right! Be sure to read the signpost. Press ↑ and the ○ button to read it.

...See you!

オレは あきらめた!

あばよ!
messages.translation:

I gave up!
You'd better think about it too, pal...

So long!

ウワッ!やめろョ

オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:

Got anything to eat?...

messages.original:

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな

What, you're giving me that?

Thanks! You saved me!
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa. Nice to meet you.

messages.original:
そうだ!!
とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?

I'll teach you a special move.

かくれてたんだけど よくわかったな・・・
messages.translation:
...Aw... you found me already!

I was hiding, and you still figured it out...

messages.original:
よし! いいことおしえてやるよ

この小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるいけ、
そして、この小屋の先を上に行くと
100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ
messages.translation:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

Go straight back behind this hut and you'll come to the Old Pond,
and if you go up past this hut,
an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there.

messages.original:
え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・
そんなことより まず行ってみろよ、
ウソじゃないから・・・

そのあとで また会おうや
messages.translation:
Huh? ...Me?...
Never mind that, go and see for yourself first,
I'm not lying...

We'll meet again after that.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・
messages.translation: What?! You've already been there?... I see...

messages.original:
100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you met the 100-Year-Old Man?

Once you have, come see me again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you been to the Old Pond?

Once you have, come see me again.

messages.original:
どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ

じまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってんだ
messages.translation:
See, I wasn't lying, was I?

Not to brag, but I know all kinds of things.

messages.original:
・・・あぁ、オイラかい?

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh, me?

I'm Yan. Yan of the Hidden Village...

messages.original:
いつも かくれてるんだけど、
だれも見つけられないんだ・・・

また見つけられたら そのときも
いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:
I'm always hiding, but nobody can ever find me...

If you find me again, I'll tell you something good then too!
...If you can find me, that is.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... this is starting to be fun...
Do your best to find me!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
You're thinking of going on ahead?

But... can you swim?

messages.original:
いかん、いかん

今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが
次からそうはいかん

そこのトビラの先は
泳げないと行けんのだから・・・

悪いことはいわん、
今はやめた方がいい・・・

いつか 泳げるようになってから行くんだナ

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!
messages.translation:
No, no.

A turtle helped you this time, but it won't go like that next time.

You can't go past that door unless you can swim, so...

I'm not saying this to be mean, but you'd better not go now...

Go when you've learned to swim someday, all right?

Oh, right!
Aren't you hungry?

Take this!

messages.original: じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや
messages.translation: See you, kid. Be careful out there.

messages.original:

・・・でも、ここには カギが かかっててな、
いまのところ 向こう側にはいけないんだ・・・
messages.translation:
Oh! So you can swim...
But it's locked here,
and for now you can't get to the other side...

messages.original:
ん〜っ・・・見たところ 文明の国にいる
鉄人の作ったカギみたいだけどナ・・・
messages.translation:

made by the Iron People of the civilized land, but...

messages.original:
な〜んだ 持ってたんかィ・・・
でも、気ィつけて行けよ・・・

おれは、キノコの森近くの浜辺で ふねにのってるから
気が向いたら のぞいてくれや

おっ そうだ! ハラへってないかィ? 
これ、もってけよ
messages.translation:
Oh, you already had it...
But be careful out there...

I'm on a boat at the beach near the Mushroom Forest,
so stop by if you feel like it.

Oh, right! Aren't you hungry?
Take this.

messages.original:
ダートモトクロスレース
レッツ チャレンジ!!
messages.translation:
Dirt Motocross Race
Take the Challenge!!

messages.original:

方向キー←か→ を押しつづけると 回転する
逆回転したいときは 逆の方向キーを押す

Keep pressing the ← or → direction key to spin.

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

会ってきいてみろよ

messages.translation:
Is this your first time on this land?

I used to live here, but things seem to have changed somehow.

I don't know what's going on, but if there's something you want to know, there's a cabin way up ahead —

an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there. Go meet him and ask.

But it's gotten dangerous around here too, so be careful.

Oh, right! Be sure to read the signpost. Press ↑ and the ○ button to read it.

...See you!

100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ

Go straight back behind this hut and you'll come to the Old Pond,
and if you go up past this hut,
an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there.

ウソじゃないから・・・

Huh? ...Me?...
Never mind that, go and see for yourself first,
I'm not lying...

We'll meet again after that.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・

messages.original:
100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや

Have you met the 100-Year-Old Man?

Once you have, come see me again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや

Have you been to the Old Pond?

Once you have, come see me again.

messages.original:

See, I wasn't lying, was I?

Not to brag, but I know all kinds of things.

messages.original:

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・

I'm Yan. Yan of the Hidden Village...

messages.original:

いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:

If you find me again, I'll tell you something good then too!
...If you can find me, that is.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... this is starting to be fun...
Do your best to find me!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
You're thinking of going on ahead?

But... can you swim?

messages.original:

そこのトビラの先は

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!

A turtle helped you this time, but it won't go like that next time.

You can't go past that door unless you can swim, so...

I'm not saying this to be mean, but you'd better not go now...

Go when you've learned to swim someday, all right?

Oh, right!
Aren't you hungry?

Take this!

messages.original: じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや

messages.original:

messages.translation:

これ、もってけよ

Take this.

messages.translation:
Is this your first time on this land?

I used to live here, but things seem to have changed somehow.

I don't know what's going on, but if there's something you want to know, there's a cabin way up ahead —

an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there. Go meet him and ask.

But it's gotten dangerous around here too, so be careful.

Oh, right! Be sure to read the signpost. Press ↑ and the ○ button to read it.

...See you!

So, would you gather all the chicks from the eggs around here?

I'm counting on you.

You kept them in your stomach!?

......Hoh......
The Koma Buta took your grandfather's keepsake bracelet...?

Hm, I see...
The truth is...

messages.original:

・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな

きっと力になってくれるはずじゃ・・・

ホレ、これをやろう・・・100年のカギじゃ

I meant to give you the 100-Year Bell,

If you find something that looks like it,

messages.original: ・・・おおっ、かえってきたか

この土地は はじめてか?

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this your first time on this land?

I used to live here, but things seem to have changed somehow.

I don't know what's going on, but if there's something you want to know, there's a cabin way up ahead —

an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there. Go meet him and ask.

But it's gotten dangerous around here too, so be careful.

Oh, right! Be sure to read the signpost. Press ↑ and the ○ button to read it.

...See you!

messages.original:

オレは あきらめた!
にぃちゃんも考えた方がいいぜ・・・

あばよ!
messages.translation:
From what I hear, if you had a Rampaging Tornado you could manage somehow...
But where on earth would a thing like that be...?

I gave up!
You'd better think about it too, pal...

So long!

messages.original: ちょっと まてよ
ウワッ!やめろョ

オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:
I'm starving and in a foul mood right now.
Got anything to eat?...
If not, come back later.

messages.original:
オ〜〜〜ッ!
なんだ それくれるのか?

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな
messages.translation:

What, you're giving me that?

Thanks! You saved me!
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa. Nice to meet you.

messages.original:

とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?
messages.translation:

I'll teach you a special move.

Ready?

100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ

Go straight back behind this hut and you'll come to the Old Pond,
and if you go up past this hut,
an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there.

Never mind that, go and see for yourself first,
I'm not lying...

We'll meet again after that.

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

messages.translation:
Is this your first time on this land?

I used to live here, but things seem to have changed somehow.

I don't know what's going on, but if there's something you want to know, there's a cabin way up ahead —

an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there. Go meet him and ask.

But it's gotten dangerous around here too, so be careful.

Oh, right! Be sure to read the signpost. Press ↑ and the ○ button to read it.

...See you!
